# 2023: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 4,686 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2023.sqlite](2023.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `da47abd202bdad798fd4a1e60114fc8434b63aa32ec8b14c88e444e2e8928071`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 7. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 2; partial: 5; without a full-event review: 4,679. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## Source handling notes

- **2023-01-29, DEPTH_JUMP, source line 20.** Missing intermediate list depth; actual depth retained Resolution: Preserve the actual source list depth and parent relationship without inventing a missing intermediate bullet. Source fragment: \*\*At least 41 people are killed and two others are injured when a bus falls off a bridge and catches fire in \[\[Lasbela District\]\], \[\[Balochistan, Pakistan\|Balochistan\]\], \[\[Pakistan\]\]. \[https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bus-crash-southern-pakistan-kills-41-local-media-2023-01-29/ (Reuters)\]

- **2023-08-10, INLINE_TEMPLATE, source line 49.** Unknown or malformed markup retained verbatim Resolution: Retain the original citation-needed template and its September 2025 annotation verbatim. This is an explicit source reliability flag, not permission to remove or independently approve the claim. Source fragment: \*The \[\[United States House Oversight Subcommittee on Government Operations\|United States House Subcommittee on Government Operations and the Federal Workforce\]\] holds a televised investigative hearing on the U.S. government's response to and overall recovery efforts from \[\[Hurricane Ian\]\], which struck \[\[Florida\]\] in September 2022. \[https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4149077-lawmakers-grill-feds-over-delays-in-hurricane-ian-response/ (''The Hill'')\]\{\{Citation needed\|date=September 2025\}\}

- **2023-12-30, UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT, source line 14.** Unrecognized structural content retained in warning Resolution: Standing user-approved handling: retain the unbulleted military claim and its citation as unclassified source material and a research lead; do not invent an event, category assignment or missing bullet. Source fragment: The \[\[Israel Defense Forces\]\] says that dozens of militants killed in \[\[Gaza Strip\|Gaza\]\] amid continued tank and aerial assaults on \[\[Khan Yunis\]\]. \[https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog\_entry/israeli-forces-eliminate-dozens-of-gunmen-in-gaza-city-destroy-infrastructure-idf/ (Times of Israel)\]

- **2023-12-30, ORPHAN_TOPIC, source line 13.** Topic has no child; preserved Resolution: Standing user-approved handling: preserve the bare topic as childless and visibly flagged; the unbulleted following paragraph is not silently made its child. Source fragment: \*\[\[Israel–Hamas war\]\]

## January

### 2023-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1331122521](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%201&oldid=1331122521>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Islamic State–Taliban conflict / 2023 Kabul airport bombing.

**Archived source account.** Several people are killed by an Islamic State bombing at a checkpoint outside the military airport in Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/1/several-feared-dead-in-blast-outside-kabul-military-airport>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel's role in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Two soldiers are killed during a series of Israeli airstrikes at Damascus International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/2/israeli-raid-shuts-down-damascus-airport-says-syria-military>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict / 2023 Rajouri attacks.

**Archived source account.** Four civilians are killed and six others injured when two gunmen open fire against Hindu people's homes in Rajouri district, Jammu and Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/rajouri-terror-attack-jammu-and-kashmir-terrorists-barge-into-hindu-houses-kill-civilians-2316140-2023-01-02>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-0-12"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war / 2023 Ciudad Juárez prison attack.

**Archived source account.** Ten prison officers and four inmates are killed in an armed attack on a prison in Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua, Mexico, in which 24 prisoners escaped.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/armed-attack-on-mexican-jail-leaves-14-dead-1177101.html>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-0-14"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians are killed and three more injured during confrontations with Israeli soldiers who stormed Kafr Dan to demolish the homes of two Palestinians killed in a shootout at a checkpoint in Jenin several months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/2/israeli-forces-kill-two-palestinian-men-occupied-west-bank>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-01-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2023 inflation surge / Canadian property bubble.

**Archived source account.** Canada enacts a law prohibiting foreigners, except for immigrants and permanent residents, from acquiring residential areas in the country for two years in response to a real-estate bubble.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Business](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/01/business/canada-bans-home-purchases-foreigners/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and many others are injured during a stampede at a concert in Kampala, Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/1/stampede-during-new-year-fireworks-kills-at-least-nine-in-uganda>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-01-01-3-2"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Australia and Canada announce that they will require travelers from China to present a negative COVID-19 test in order to enter their countries beginning on January 5.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/canada-to-require-negative-covid-19-test-for-air-travellers-coming-from-china-1.6214110>); [Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/national/covid-test-to-be-required-for-chinese-travellers-20230101-p5c9q0.html>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-3-4"></a>

Context: Climate change in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The British arm of climate protest group Extinction Rebellion announces it will "temporarily" shift away from using public disruption as a primary tactic.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/extinction-rebellion-uk-halt-disruptive-protests-2023-01-01/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three police officers are wounded in a machete attack during New Year's Eve celebrations in Times Square, New York City, United States. The suspect, a 19-year-old male from Maine, is also wounded and has been arrested, with jihadist motives being suspected.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/nypd-officers-injured-machete-attack-times-square-new-years-eve-rcna63855>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-01-5-2"></a>

Context: Enlargement of the eurozone / Croatia and the euro.

**Archived source account.** Croatia changes its national currency from the kuna to the euro to become 20th member state of the Eurozone, and joins the European passport-free zone, the Schengen Area.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.macaubusiness.com/croatia-switches-to-euro-enters-borderless-europe-club/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-01-5-4"></a>

Context: Third inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

**Archived source account.** Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is sworn in as President of Brazil for the third time in his political career.

Source citations (as archived): [Télam](<https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202301/615958-asuncion-lula-da-silva-brasil.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-01-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Philippine airspace closure.

**Archived source account.** The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines closes the country's airspace for nearly six hours due to a power outage in its air traffic management center, affecting more than 280 commercial flights and more than 56,000 passengers.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-01-01/manila-flights-on-hold-due-to-technical-issues-on-new-year-s-day>).

### 2023-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1353539829](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%202&oldid=1353539829>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict / 2023 Rajouri attacks.

**Archived source account.** Two children are killed and four other people are injured by an explosion outside the home of one of the four Hindus who were killed yesterday in Rajouri district, Jammu and Kashmir, India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/many-killed-in-blast-at-rajouris-dangri-village/article66329258.ece/amp/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Two firefighters and three civilians are killed in an armed attack by Islamist insurgents along a highway between Bamako and Ségou.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/two-firefighters-three-civilians-killed-in-mali-attack-ministry-01672782909>).

<a id="event-2023-01-02-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests continue for a fifth day in Las Anod, Somaliland, with protesters demanding that the city be governed by Puntland instead of by Somaliland. Twenty people are killed in clashes between protestors and security forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/amp/2023/01/02/deadly-clashes-between-protesters-and-security-forces-in-somaliland/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Gold Coast mid-air collision.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and eight others are injured when two helicopters collide near the Sea World theme park in Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-01-02/gold-coast-helicopter-major-incident/101822136>).

<a id="event-2023-01-02-1-3"></a>

Context: New County Hotel fire.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed after a fire broke out at New County Hotel in Perth, Scotland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-tayside-central-64144080>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-01-02-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Malawi suspends the opening of schools in Lilongwe and Blantyre due to an outbreak of cholera, which has killed 595 people so far, including 19 people on New Year's Eve.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64144610>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Indian banknote demonetisation.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India upholds the legality of the government's decision to demonetise all ₹500 and ₹1,000 banknotes of the Mahatma Gandhi Series in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/india-government-business-modi-397ca5ebd3084cd57c27f94fbebd8420>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Qatar corruption scandal at the European Parliament.

**Archived source account.** President of the European Parliament Roberta Metsola initiates a formal procedure to revoke parliamentary immunity from two MEPs allegedly involved in the scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2473675/eu-parliament-chief-moves-to-lift-two-meps-immunity>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-01-02-5-1"></a>

Context: 2022 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** Buffalo Bills safety Damar Hamlin suffers from a cardiac arrest during a Monday Night Football game against the Cincinnati Bengals and is taken to the University of Cincinnati Academic Health Center by ambulance. The NFL subsequently suspends the game and cancels it three days later.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/bengals-vs-bills-monday-night-football-game-suspended-after-buffalos-damar-hamlin-suffers-scary-injury/live/>).

### 2023-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1331925554](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%203&oldid=1331925554>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Makiivka military quarters shelling.

**Archived source account.** The Russian defense ministry increases the death toll of soldiers from a December 31 Ukrainian missile attack in Makiivka, Donetsk Oblast, to 89. The ministry attributes the casualties to the soldiers' use of mobile phones with tracking systems.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/01/04/23/russia-says-toll-from-ukraine-strike-rises-to-89>).

<a id="event-2023-01-03-0-5"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war / Aftermath of the 2023 Ciudad Juárez prison attack.

**Archived source account.** Five gunmen and two members of the security forces are killed during a shootout while searching for 30 inmates who escaped two days ago during an armed attack on a prison in Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua, Mexico. Ten prison guards and seven inmates were killed during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-64147790>).

<a id="event-2023-01-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and many more wounded during a gunfight between Houthi militants and Yemeni soldiers in Taiz.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20230104/244c4bb2fc4d431e800b09aa748be540/c.html>).

<a id="event-2023-01-03-0-9"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The visit of the Israeli Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir to the Temple Mount in Jerusalem results in protests by Palestinians as well as condemnation of the visit by several Arab countries, who consider the site to be part of the Al-Aqsa Mosque.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-64150409>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/3/in-provocation-israel-far-right-minister-enters-al-aqsa-compound>).

<a id="event-2023-01-03-0-11"></a>

Context: Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-eight civilians are found dead in the town of Nouna, in northwest Burkina Faso. Burkinabé human rights groups say that the killings were perpetrated by pro-government militia VDP on December 15, 18, and 22.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlas](<https://theatlasnews.co/brief/2023/01/03/28-civilians-executed-in-burkina-faso-rights-group-blames-government-militia/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/bodies-28-men-found-shot-dead-burkina-faso-prosecutors-2023-01-03/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-03-1-2"></a>

Context: 2021–2023 global energy crisis / 2022–2023 Pakistan economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government orders the closure of all shopping malls and retail markets by 8:30 p.m. (PKT) daily as part of an energy conservation plan to offset increasing energy prices.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-shuts-markets-evenings-under-energy-conservation-plan-minister-2023-01-03/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-01-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2022–23 snooker season.

**Archived source account.** The World Professional Billiards and Snooker Association suspends Chinese players Zhang Jiankang and Zhao Xintong from the World Snooker Tour as part of a match-fixing investigation involving ten Chinese players.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230103-china-s-zhao-xintong-and-zhang-jiankang-suspended-in-snooker-fixing-probe>).

<a id="event-2023-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: 2023 PDC World Darts Championship.

**Archived source account.** Michael Smith wins the PDC World Darts Championship after defeating Michael van Gerwen 7–4 in the final, winning his first world title and reaching world number one on the PDC Order of Merit for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky Sports](<https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12288/12779247/world-darts-championship-michael-smith-defeats-michael-van-gerwen-to-claim-glory-at-alexandra-palace>).

### 2023-01-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1191604687](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%204&oldid=1191604687>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War / Mahas bombings.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab jihadists kill 35 people in a double car bombing outside a politician's home and a market in Mahas District, Hiran, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-64167474>).

<a id="event-2023-01-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Two intelligence officers, including the director of the provincial counterterrorism department, are shot dead outside a restaurant in Khanewal, Punjab, Pakistan, by suspected Pakistani Taliban gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/4/two-pakistan-intelligence-officers-gunned-down-in-punjab-province>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-01-04-1-1"></a>

Context: \#MeToo movement.

**Archived source account.** Actors Leonard Whiting and Olivia Hussey, who starred in the 1968 film adaptation of William Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet, file a lawsuit in the Los Angeles County Superior Court against Paramount Pictures for US$500 million, alleging sexual abuse, sexual harassment, and fraud, and for being filmed in the nude without their knowledge.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://apnews.com/article/entertainment-movies-franco-zeffirelli-lawsuits-legal-proceedings-f62cad4b78eec5d0486eef8a20ce35d5>); [Variety](<https://variety.com/2023/film/news/romeo-and-juliet-child-abuse-nude-scene-lawsuit-1235477837/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Meta Platforms is fined €390 million by the European Union, claiming that the company's collection of personal data from Facebook and Instagram accounts for personalized ads was in violation of EU privacy laws.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/irish-privacy-regulator-fines-meta-more-than-400-mln-2023-01-04/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-04-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Competition Commission of India rejects an appeal from Google over its ruling in October that Google's dominant position in the search engine market and control of the Android app store violated India's antitrust laws.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/indian-tribunal-declines-interim-stay-google-android-related-antitrust-ruling-2023-01-04/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-01-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Equatorial Guinea–Spain relations.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Spain says that it will investigate two sons of Equatorial Guinean president Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo over the kidnapping and torture of two Spanish citizens who oppose Obiang's rule.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/spanish-court-investigates-equatorial-guinea-leader-s-son-for-kidnapping/6904121.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Killing of the Haight family.

**Archived source account.** Three adults and five children are found dead inside a home in Enoch, Utah, United States, after police conduct a welfare check.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/04/us/enoch-utah-shooting-dead.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-01-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Katrina.

**Archived source account.** The National Hurricane Center publishes a new Tropical Cyclone Report for Hurricane Katrina, lowering the death toll from over 1,800 to 1,392.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<https://twitter.com/NHC_Atlantic/status/1610704294533267457>); [National Hurricane Center](<https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/data/tcr/AL122005_Katrina.pdf>).

### 2023-01-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1179318295](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%205&oldid=1179318295>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-05-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2023 Russian Christmas truce proposal.

**Archived source account.** Following the suggestion of Patriarch Kirill of Moscow, Russian President Vladimir Putin announces a unilateral ceasefire on January 6–7 in connection with Orthodox Christmas. However, Ukraine rejects an offer to respond with a mutual ceasefire, citing lack of trust.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-war-ukraine-latest-russia-says-63-servicemen-killed-makiivka-2023-01-02/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Foreign aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Germany agree to send Bradley Fighting Vehicles and Marder infantry fighting vehicles to Ukraine. Germany will also supply the Ukrainian military with a MIM-104 Patriot surface-to-air missile system.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jan/05/germany-tanks-ukraine-russia-war>); [AFP](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/white-house-says-us-germany-sending-armored-vehicles-to-ukraine/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war / 2023 Sinaloa unrest.

**Archived source account.** The army arrests Ovidio Guzmán López, the son of incarcerated drug lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán, in Culiacán, Sinaloa. The arrest is followed by state-wide unrest, with many schools and airports closed. Ten soldiers and 19 gang members are killed during the unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-64179356>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jan/05/mexican-authorities-recapture-drug-lord-el-chapo-son>).

<a id="event-2023-01-05-0-11"></a>

Context: Afghanistan conflict / Islamic State–Taliban conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban says that its forces have killed eight Islamic State insurgents, including foreign nationals, and arrested seven others in a series of raids in Kabul and the western Nimruz Province, following recent attacks by the jihadist group.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/5/taliban-says-eight-isil-fighters-killed-in-raids-in-afghanistan>).

<a id="event-2023-01-05-0-13"></a>

Context: Aegean dispute.

**Archived source account.** A Turkish coast guard vessel exchanges warning shots with a Greek coast guard vessel near the Greek island of Farmakonisi.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/warning-shots-fired-as-greek-turkish-patrol-boats-face-off/ar-AA160vNQ?ocid=entnewsntp&amp;cvid=5d1d1b2173b44c3c80638debb7a4ed03>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and nine others are injured after a building collapses in Mosul, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [NewsToday](<https://newstodaynet.com/2023/01/07/building-collapse-in-iraq-kills-3-injures-9/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-01-05-2-3"></a>

Context: COVID-19 pandemic / COVID-19 pandemic in Greece / Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** Greece announces that travelers from China will require a negative COVID-19 test in order to enter the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greece-require-negative-covid-tests-travellers-china-2023-01-05/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Death and funeral of Pope Benedict XVI.

**Archived source account.** The funeral for Pope emeritus Benedict XVI takes place in St. Peter's Square, Vatican City, with at least 50,000 attendees.

**Archived source account.** Ugandan Health Minister Jane Aceng declares an end to the outbreak of Sudan ebolavirus in the country that has killed 77 people since September.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-declares-end-ebola-outbreak-2023-01-11/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-01-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Antony Blinken announces that Japan and the United States will include space warfare as a trigger for the Treaty of Mutual Cooperation and Security.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/world/857126/us-japan-agree-space-attacks-covered-by-joint-defense-treaty/story/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-11-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed and 13 others injured when a man rams his vehicle into a crowd in Guangzhou, China.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-64245246>).

<a id="event-2023-01-11-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are injured in a mass stabbing at the Gare du Nord train station in Paris, France. The attacker is shot by police, arrested, and hospitalized.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64234281>).

<a id="event-2023-01-11-3-3"></a>

Context: Joe Biden classified documents incident.

**Archived source account.** Aides to the President of the United States Joe Biden discover a second set of classified documents besides those found on Monday in a Washington, D.C. office. The White House acknowledges the discovery.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/biden-aides-find-second-batch-classified-documents-new-location-rcna65371>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-01-11-4-1"></a>

Context: 2023 FAA system outage.

**Archived source account.** For the first time since 9/11, the FAA issues a nationwide ground stop in the United States following the failure of the FAA's NOTAM system.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2023/01/11/us-faa-says-flight-personnel-alert-system-not-processing-updates-after-outage.html>).

<a id="event-2023-01-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The launch of an unmanned ABL Space Systems RS1 rocket fails at the Pacific Spaceport Complex – Alaska in Kodiak, Alaska, United States. The rocket crashes during the launch, damaging the launch platform and destroying the rocket and its cargo.

Source citations (as archived): [Anchorage Daily News](<https://www.adn.com/business-economy/2023/01/11/abl-rocket-crashes-after-liftoff-from-kodiak-spaceport-damages-launch-pad/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's postal service Royal Mail tells people to stop sending mail abroad due to a "cyber incident" that is causing severe disruption to mail delivery, with "minor delays" to mail coming into the UK also being reported. It is later confirmed to be a ransomware attack from a Russia-linked hacker group.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-64231473>).

### 2023-01-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362537117](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2012&oldid=1362537117>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli soldiers raid the village of Qabatiya in the West Bank, killing two Palestinian men. In a separate incident, Israeli forces arrest an 18-year-old Palestinian man and kill his father in the Qalandia refugee camp.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/palestinians-say-israeli-army-kills-man-in-west-bank-raid/2023/01/12/2198b246-9244-11ed-90f8-53661ac5d9b9_story.html>); [Ynetnews](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/rj00css6qo>).

<a id="event-2023-01-12-0-3"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 Peruvian political protests.

**Archived source account.** The city of Cusco is placed under red alert after one person is killed and 17 others are injured in clashes between protesters and police.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/12/americas/peru-anti-government-protests-intl/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-12-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2023 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** The National Institute of Statistics and Census of Argentina records a 94.8% inflation rate for its economy in 2022, the highest since 1991.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.batimes.com.ar/news/economy/argentina-ended-2022-with-948-inflation-highest-rate-in-32-years.phtml>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Tornado outbreak of January 12, 2023.

**Archived source account.** A tornado outbreak in the US states of Alabama and Georgia damages several towns and kills at least six people.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/weather/2023/01/12/southern-storms-deaths-alabama-tornado-damage/11041594002/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-12-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A truck crashes into several minibus taxis at an intersection in Roodepoort, Gauteng, South Africa, killing five people and injuring nine others.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<https://www.news24.com/news24/southafrica/news/absolute-mayhem-5-killed-several-injured-after-truck-crashes-into-taxis-in-roodepoort-20230112>).

<a id="event-2023-01-12-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion at a propane store in Saint-Roch-de-l’Achigan, Quebec, Canada leaves three people missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CFCF-DT](<https://montreal.ctvnews.ca/service-planned-after-explosion-that-left-3-missing-in-st-roch-de-l-achigan-que-1.6230959>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-01-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Swedish mining company LKAB discovers Europe's largest known deposit of rare-earth elements in Kiruna, Sweden.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/swedens-lkab-finds-europes-biggest-deposit-rare-earth-metals-2023-01-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-12-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Meteorological Organization of the United Nations reports an average global temperature of about 1.15 °C above pre-industrial levels in 2022, confirming that the last eight years were the highest temperatures recorded on Earth since records began.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.philstar.com/headlines/climate-and-environment/2023/01/13/2237352/un-confirms-2022-among-eight-hottest-years-record>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-12-4-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Beninese parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court declares that the parties supporting President Patrice Talon, including the Progressive Union for Renewal and the Republican Bloc, have won a majority of 81 out of 109 seats in the National Assembly. The parties have been accused of electoral fraud by the opposition Democrats party, who plan to contest the results.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230112-benin-pro-govt-parties-win-parliament-majority>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-01-12-5-1"></a>

Context: International response to the treatment of women by the Taliban.

**Archived source account.** Cricket Australia announces the withdrawal of the Australia national team from their One Day International matches against Afghanistan scheduled for March in response to the Taliban government's recent prohibitions of education and employment for women.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/12/sport/australia-afghanistan-cricket-taliban-intl-hnk-spt/index.html>).

### 2023-01-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364852929](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2013&oldid=1364852929>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Soledar.

**Archived source account.** Russia's defence ministry says that its forces have taken full control of Soledar in Donetsk Oblast. However, Ukraine denies the fall of the city and its salt mines, claiming that the battle was still ongoing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64263119>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Lithuania–Latvia pipeline explosion.

**Archived source account.** A large explosion occurs on the Lithuania–Latvia Interconnection natural gas pipeline in Pasvalys District Municipality, Lithuania. Latvian Defence Minster Artis Pabriks says that the cause of the explosion would be investigated and that sabotage "could not be ruled out".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-64267736>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/lithuania-latvia-gas-pipeline-hit-by-explosion-operator-says-2023-01-13/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the assassination of Shinzo Abe.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors in Japan charge the 42-year-old accused killer of former prime minister Shinzo Abe with murder. Additional charges are expected after the man was found competent by psychiatrists earlier this week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Asahi Shimbun](<https://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14813434>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/japan-prosecutors-indict-yamagami-murder-ex-prime-minister-abe-yomiuri-2023-01-13/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-13-2-3"></a>

Context: New York investigations of The Trump Organization.

**Archived source account.** The New York County Courthouse issues the maximum allowable $1.6 million fine on the Trump Organization, former president Donald Trump's conglomerate, for tax fraud, conspiracy, and falsifying business records.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230113-trump-organization-fined-1-6-mn-for-tax-fraud>).

<a id="event-2023-01-13-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The British government announces a ban on single-use plastic cutlery, plates, polystyrene cups, bowls, and balloon sticks in England beginning in October as part of an effort to reduce plastic pollution. The ban will apply to all retailers, takeaways, and food vendors.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-64253130>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Czech presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Czechs head to the polls to elect their president. Incumbent Miloš Zeman is not eligible to run for re-election, as he is term limited.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2023/01/13/andrej-babis-faces-stiff-competition-in-czech-republic-presidential-election>).

### 2023-01-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1185830266](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2014&oldid=1185830266>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-14-0-3"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure / 2023 Dnipro residential building airstrike.

**Archived source account.** Russia strikes a nine-story residential building in Dnipro with a cruise missile, killing at least 40 people, injuring 73 others and leaving dozens more missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-belarus-conduct-defensive-air-drills-sparking-fear-kyiv-new-offensive-2023-01-16/>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/1/15/russia-ukraine-live-death-toll-from-strike-in-dnipro-rises-to-14>).

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak confirms that the United Kingdom will send 14 Challenger 2 main battle tanks to Ukraine in the coming weeks, as well as 30 self-propelled AS-90 howitzers. Ukrainian troops will also be trained by the British Armed Forces to operate the tanks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/uk-has-ambition-send-tanks-ukraine-pm-sunak-tells-zelenskiy-2023-01-14/>).

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed and more than 50 injured by an al-Shabaab suicide car bombing in Buloburde, Hiran.

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinian Islamic Jihad members are killed by Israeli soldiers during a raid in Jaba, in the West Bank.

Context: Miss Universe 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/style/article/miss-universe-crowned-rbonney-gabriel-usa-intl-hnk/index.html>).

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran announces the execution of dual British Iranian citizen Alireza Akbari, who had served as a deputy for the ministry of defense, on charges of spying for the United Kingdom. British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak condemns Akbari's execution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-executes-british-iranian-national-akbari-iranian-report-2023-01-14/>).

Context: Euston shooting.

**Archived source account.** Six people are injured by a mass drive-by shooting in London, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-64286160>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-14-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Czech presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Retired general Petr Pavel and former Prime Minister Andrej Babiš advance to a runoff vote in the Czech presidential election, which will be held on January 27–28.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://www.dw.com/en/czech-republic-ex-general-pavel-wins-first-round-of-presidential-election/a-64395190>).

### 2023-01-15

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Kivu conflict / Allied Democratic Forces insurgency / Kasindi church bombing.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and 39 others are injured when a bomb explodes at a Pentecostal church in Kasindi, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Islamic State has claimed responsibility for the attack.

Taliban police spokesman Khalid Zadran condemns the killing and says that a "serious investigation has been launched".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2232881/world>).

**Archived source account.** Two suspected drug traffickers are killed in a shootout with United States Customs and Border Protection officials off the coast of Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/crime-caribbean-us-customs-and-border-protection-san-juan-puerto-rico-786327d42ea84f93f573a3561e68cbe7>).

### 2023-01-16

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Battle of Soledar.

### 2023-01-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1179317585](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2017&oldid=1179317585>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Seven soldiers, including a commander, are killed when al-Shabaab jihadists attack a military base in Hawadley, Middle Shabelle, with a suicide car bomb and gunmen.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/somalia-security-idAFKBN2TW0FL>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic, Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

**Archived source account.** The World Tourism Organization reports that the figures for international tourist arrivals worldwide had doubled in 2022 compared to the previous year, citing the easing of COVID-19 pandemic-related travel restrictions.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20230117-international-tourist-arrivals-doubled-in-2022-un>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Bear attacks.

**Archived source account.** A polar bear attacks and kills a woman and her son in Wales, Alaska, United States, after charging several others, in the first fatal attack since the early 1980s. The bear is shot and killed following the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/01/18/us/alaska-polar-bear-attack/index.html>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64315398>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-01-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Aging of China.

**Archived source account.** The National Bureau of Statistics reports that China's population, the largest in the world, declined for the first time since 1960, with a population decrease of 850,000 people reported in the past year.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230117-china-population-shrinks-for-first-time-in-over-60-years>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/01/16/business/china-birth-rate.html>).

**Archived source account.** Tanzanian opposition party Chadema organizes a political demonstration in Mwanza. This is the country's first demonstration since President Samia Suluhu Hassan abolished her predecessor John Magufuli's seven-year ban on political assembly earlier this month.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.voanews.com/a/tanzania-opposition-holds-first-rally-since-ban-lifted/6928184.html>).

### 2023-01-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1179318334](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2022&oldid=1179318334>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-22-0-2"></a>

Context: 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Germany–Russia relations, Germany–Poland relations.

**Archived source account.** German Foreign Affairs Minister Annalena Baerbock says that Germany will not prevent Poland from sending Leopard 2 main battle tanks to Ukraine which Ukrainian officials say are pivotal to defeating Russian forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/france-does-not-rule-out-sending-leclerc-tanks-ukraine-macron-2023-01-22/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese Army declares a "state of alert" after stopping Israeli bulldozers and accompanying soldiers from approaching a border fence in Southern Lebanon. Peacekeeping forces from UNIFIL have also been deployed to the area.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/lebanon-army-declares-state-of-alert-amid-tension-with-israel/2794370#>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and three others are feared dead in an apartment fire in Kobe, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2023/01/22/national/kobe-apartment-fire/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-22-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed when a five-story building collapses in Aleppo, Syria, due to a leaking of water in the building's foundation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/thirteen-killed-after-building-collapses-syrias-aleppo-state-media-2023-01-22/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and six others are injured in a fire at a two-story cottage in Qusar, Azerbaijan.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://english.news.cn/20230122/089b3d191a7740d4ba14094cef312739/c.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Cameroon find the mutilated body of prominent journalist Martinez Zogo, who had been kidnapped by unknown assailants five days ago, amid increasing violence against reporters in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/prominent-cameroon-journalist-found-dead-after-abduction-2023-01-22/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-01-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election.

**Archived source account.** The ruling Labour Party unanimously elects education and public service minister Chris Hipkins to succeed Jacinda Ardern as the party's leader following Ardern's resignation three days ago. Governor-General Cindy Kiro is expected to appoint Hipkins as the 41st prime minister of New Zealand on January 25.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/politics-jacinda-ardern-new-zealand-f9cd3434bd1ac5a7d577963077a3ea4e>).

<a id="event-2023-01-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses health and interior minister Aryeh Deri from his cabinet after the Supreme Court ruled that Deri was barred from holding a position as a cabinet minister due to his conviction for tax offenses.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230122-israel-pm-removes-top-minister-over-court-ruling>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-01-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In surfing, American lifeguard Luke Shepardson wins the 2023 edition of The Eddie at Waimea Bay on the north shore of Oahu, Hawaii, United States, after finishing with 89.1 points out of 90, defeating defending champion John John Florence.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/sports-john-florence-hawaii-surfing-57725912ad9128d34cc09558a33311e5>).

### 2023-01-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1266235549](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20January%2023&oldid=1266235549>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency / Makugwe massacre.

**Archived source account.** Allied Democratic Forces insurgents kill 23 people at a bar in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The jihadists also torched several homes and shops in the village during the attack. Islamic State claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20230123-islamic-state-group-claims-deadly-attack-in-east-dr-congo>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-01-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2023 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** Swedish music streaming service Spotify announces that it will cut 600 jobs, around 6% of its workforce, citing low revenue growth and a need to improve efficiency. Dawn Ostroff will also depart as its chief content and advertising business officer.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-64374583>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-01-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A major power outage in Pakistan leaves nearly 220 million people without electricity after a failure at the national power grid. Earlier this month, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered a reduction in energy consumption as the country faces a severe energy crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/22/asia/pakistan-power-outage-intl-hnk/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-suffers-major-power-outage-after-grid-failure-2023-01-23/>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Algerian Air Force Mi-171 helicopter crashes during a military exercise, killing three crew onboard in Aïn Defla Province, Algeria.

Source citations (as archived): [MEHR](<https://en.mehrnews.com/news/196557/3-killed-in-military-helicopter-crash-in-Algeria>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and two others are injured after a fire in a church in Beyoğlu, Istanbul, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [DailySabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/istanbul/2-die-2-injured-after-fire-at-armenian-catholic-church-in-istanbul>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-01-23-3-2"></a>

Context: Sweden–Turkey relations / Enlargement of NATO, Sweden–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan rules out Turkish support for Sweden's bid for NATO membership following the burning of a Quran outside the Turkish embassy in Stockholm by Rasmus Paludan and a series of pro-Kurdish demonstrations where protestors waved PKK flags.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nato-politics-turkey-government-recep-tayyip-erdogan-f9a568da05914a4143a033e74067b6f4>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-3-4"></a>

Context: Estonia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Estonia announces the expulsion of the Russian ambassador in Tallinn Vladimir Lipayev to reciprocate Russia's expulsion of the Estonian ambassador in Moscow Margus Laidre due to a "downgrade" of relations. Both envoys will depart their respective assignments on February 7.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/estonia-tallinn-business-67182f99b4eaae30d1fd41d12da8fa48>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-3-6"></a>

Context: Latvia–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Latvia asks Russian ambassador Mikhail Vanin to leave the country by February 24 in "full solidarity" with Estonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/estonia-latvia-russia-remove-european-union-tensions-moscow/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-01-23-4-2"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States / 2023 Monterey Park shooting.

**Archived source account.** An eleventh person dies in the hospital from injuries sustained in Saturday's mass shooting in Monterey Park, California, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2023-01-23/victims-identified-in-the-monterey-park-shooting>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-4-4"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States / 2023 Half Moon Bay shootings.

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed and one other person is injured in a shooting spree in Half Moon Bay, California, United States. A suspect is taken into custody afterwards.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<https://www.sfchronicle.com/bayarea/article/Sheriff-deputies-in-Half-Moon-Bay-responding-to-17737044.php>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-4-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2020 Beirut explosion.

**Archived source account.** Judge Tarek Bitar resumes his investigation into the explosion, 13 months after Hezbollah officials filed complaints against Bitar that prompted him to suspend the investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.zawya.com/en/world/middle-east/lebanon-port-blast-probe-resumes-after-13-months-halt-judicial-source-ttbprai2>).

<a id="event-2023-01-23-4-8"></a>

Context: Eugenics in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Kumamoto district court orders the government to compensate two plaintiffs JPY 22 million (US$170,000) worth of damages for their compulsory sterilization under the now-obsolete Eugenic Protection Act of 1948.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyodo News](<https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2023/01/0bccfc853dde-update1-japan-court-orders-govt-to-pay-damages-over-forced-sterilization.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-01-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A new study by seismologists at Peking University in Beijing says that Earth's inner core stopped rotating faster than the rest of the planet in 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-023-00167-1>); [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2355859-earthquakes-suggest-earths-core-has-started-spinning-more-slowly/>).

Context: Corruption in Ukraine.

<a id="event-2023-01-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Doomsday Clock.

Context: 2022–2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda tensions.

<a id="event-2023-01-25-0-10"></a>

Context: Algeciras church attacks.

<a id="event-2023-01-25-1-0"></a>

UNESCO cites ongoing conflicts and lack of funding due to the Lebanese liquidity crisis as the reasons for their inclusion.

Context: 2021–2023 inflation surge.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

Ukrainian general Valerii Zaluzhnyi says that at least 20 missiles have been intercepted over the capital Kyiv.

### 2023-01-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-01-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Forces of the Wagner Group say that they have captured the village of Blahodatne, north of Bakhmut. However, Ukraine rejects the claim and says that it repelled the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2023/01/29/ukraine-says-repelled-attack-near-blahodatne-russias-wagner-claims-control-a80073>).

<a id="event-2023-01-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces shell the city of Kherson, killing three people, injuring six others, and damaging a hospital, school, and bus station.

<a id="event-2023-01-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in the Sahel / Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** The governor of Comoé Province reports that 15 corpses, who were among 24 passengers of two minibuses that departed the provincial capital of Banfora when suspected jihadists hijacked the buses in Linguekoro and coerced the passengers to walk to Mangodara, were discovered near Linguekoro. The governor also reports that 15 other passengers had been abducted.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/01/31/23/suspected-jihadists-kill-28-in-troubled-burkina-faso>).

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/warplanes-said-to-strike-convoy-of-iranian-militia-trucks-on-syria-iraq-border/>).

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** An 18-year-old Palestinian man is shot dead by a group of Israeli civilians near the settlement of Kedumim, in the West Bank. In a separate incident, a Palestinian civilian home is set on fire by settlers. The occupants were not there at the time of the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/29/israeli-guards-kill-palestinian-near-west-bank-settlement>).

Editorial date: 2023-02-03. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: train composition and the derailment are corroborated; the remaining clauses are not independently established here. Original wording is preserved.

Evidence: [NTSB](<https://www.ntsb.gov/news/press-releases/pages/nr20230214.aspx>).

Original source account: A train carrying 20 cars of hazardous material derailed in East Palestine, Ohio. The material was burned, which released hydrogen chloride and phosgene into the air, causing an evacuation of all residents within a one-mile radius of the crash and an emergency response across three states.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

Context: 2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-02-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in Antarctica.

**Archived source account.** The National Snow and Ice Data Center of the United States reports that the Antarctic sea ice decreased to 1.91 million km2 within the week, the smallest remaining ice area since records began in 1979.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/02/16/Vietnam-jails-South-Koreans-for-people-smuggling-during-pandemic->).

<a id="event-2023-02-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Russia in the Council of Europe.

<a id="event-2023-02-16-5-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/portugal-ends-golden-visas-curtails-airbnb-rentals-address-housing-crisis-2023-02-16/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-02-16-6-2"></a>

Context: 2022–23 FIS Alpine Ski World Cup / FIS Alpine World Ski Championships 2023.

**Archived source account.** American alpine skier Mikaela Shiffrin wins her seventh career alpine world championships gold medal in the women's giant slalom of the 2023 edition in the French Alps, making her the most successful skier in the modern era with an overall tally of 13 medals from 16 career world championship races.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/feb/16/mikaela-shiffrin-breaks-modern-record-with-gold-in-gs-at-world-championshps>).

However, the whereabouts of the two pilots and two Australian passengers on board have yet to be located due to inclement weather.

Instead, "medical, environmental and social factors can explain" many symptoms.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/havana-syndrome-intelligence-anonalous-health-incidents-diplomats-cf087b8255532056b5597232544bfb71>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/havana-syndrome-not-caused-by-foreign-adversary-us-intel-finds-2023-03-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-03-10-2-2"></a>

<a id="event-2023-03-30-3-2"></a>

Context: Enlargement of NATO, Finland–NATO relations / Finland–Turkey relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/turkish-parliament-ratifies-finlands-nato-membership>).

<a id="event-2023-03-30-3-4"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice (ICJ) rules that the United States violated its 1955 friendship treaty with Iran when it allowed its domestic courts to freeze assets held by Iranian companies, but said that the ICJ does not have jurisdiction over the US$1.75 billion worth of frozen assets held by the Central Bank of Iran. Both countries claimed victory in the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/world-court-rule-iran-us-frozen-assets-claim-2023-03-30/>).

**Archived source account.** The Vatican officially repudiates the discovery doctrine, writing that the 15th-century papal bulls which promoted it were "manipulated for political purposes by competing colonial powers in order to justify immoral acts against indigenous peoples that were carried out, at times, without opposition from ecclesiastical authorities".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/vatican-rejects-doctrine-of-discovery-justifying-colonialism>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/30/austria-far-right-lawmakers-walk-out-of-zelenskyy-speech>).

### 2023-04-01

#### Business and economy

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg Tax](<https://news.bloombergtax.com/daily-tax-report-international/indias-angel-tax-spreads-its-wings-over-nonresident-investors>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-04-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Tornado outbreak of March 31 – April 1, 2023.

**Archived source account.** The toll from yesterday's tornado outbreak rises to 32 people dead and at least 90 injuries, especially in the states of Arkansas and Illinois.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/04/02/us/us-severe-storm-south-midwest-sunday/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-04-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and another is injured after a hot air balloon catches fire near Teotihuacan, State of Mexico, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-hot-air-balloon-accident-teotihuacan-4431c201a5401646c613b318145beea0>).

<a id="event-2023-04-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia assumes the Presidency of the United Nations Security Council as part of the standard monthly rotation among the council's 15 members.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-65146557>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-04-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Professor Alan Jamieson of the University of Western Australia's Minderoo-UWA Deep Sea Research Centre announces that his team has captured footage of a snailfish species, Pseudoliparis belyaevi, swimming at 8336 m in the Izu–Ogasawara Trench off Japan's southern coast. This is the lowest depth recorded for any fish, and closest to the estimated maximum depth possible for fish to survive.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-65148876>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-04-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Israel's role in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Force launches airstrikes near Damascus, killing two civilians, according to Syrian state media. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights says that an "unknown number" of Iran-backed militants were also killed in the strikes, which targeted a counter-battery radar in As-Suwayda Governorate, and a glass factory in al-Kiswah, Rif Dimashq Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20230404-two-civilians-killed-in-israeli-air-strike-on-syria-s-damascus>).

Context: War against the Islamic State.

**Archived source account.** United States Central Command says that U.S. forces killed senior Islamic State leader Khalid 'Aydd Ahmad al-Jabouri, who was allegedly planning attacks in Europe during Easter, in an overnight raid in rebel-held northwest Syria. The U.S. also says that there were no civilian casualties in the raid.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-military-operation-kills-islamic-state-leader-syria-officials-2023-04-04/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-04-15-0-4"></a>

Context: 2019–2026 Sudanese transition to democracy / Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum / RSF occupation of the Khartoum International Airport.

**Archived source account.** Fighting occurs across Sudan three days after the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) mobilized. The RSF claims to have captured Khartoum International Airport and the presidential palace in Khartoum. At least 56 civilians are killed and 595 others are injured, with several military personnel and rebel forces also being killed. Several Egyptian troops are also taken prisoner by the RSF.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-65284945>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/15/heavy-gunfire-heard-south-of-sudanese-capital-khartoum>); [Al Jazeera 2](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/16/egyptian-soldiers-captured-in-sudan-to-be-returned-says-rsf>).

Context: 2019–2026 Sudanese transition to democracy / Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum / RSF occupation of the Khartoum International Airport.

**Archived source account.** Chad closes its border with Sudan as heavy fighting continues between the Sudanese military and rebel forces.

Context: 2019–2026 Sudanese transition to democracy / Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum / RSF occupation of the Khartoum International Airport.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Japan Fumio Kishida is evacuated during a speech in Saikazaki, Wakayama, Kansai, Japan, after an "explosion-like sound" is heard. A suspect, believed to have thrown a smoke bomb, is arrested.

<a id="event-2023-04-15-0-12"></a>

<a id="event-2023-04-15-0-14"></a>

Context: Encounter killing.

**Archived source account.** Former Indian Parliament member Atiq Ahmed, and his brother Ashraf Ahmed, are assassinated on live television while giving an interview to reporters in Allahabad, while in the custody of police, Uttar Pradesh, India. In response to the murders, the Uttar Pradesh government bars gatherings of more than four people across the entire state. His son had already been killed in an encounter a month earlier. The government shuts down the Internet access in the Allahabad district.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/04/16/india/former-indian-lawmaker-killed-intl/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india/former-indian-lawmaker-slain-live-tv-while-police-custody-state-restricts-2023-04-16/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-65290042>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/16/ex-mp-atiq-ahmed-brother-shot-dead-on-live-tv-in-india>); [Hindustan Times](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/lucknow-news/atiq-ahmad-s-son-asad-wanted-in-umesh-pal-case-killed-in-encounter-101681371436932.html>); [The Indian Express](<https://indianexpress.com/article/india/gangster-turned-politician-atiq-ahmeds-son-asad-killed-in-encounter-in-jhansi-8554227/>); [The Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/india/up-police-intensifies-security-in-prayagraj-internet-services-shut-sec-144-imposed/articleshow/99530848.cms>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-04-16-0-2"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese military is said to have retaken control of the presidential palace and other key government installations in Khartoum. The military says Khartoum International Airport remains under the control of Rapid Support Forces, but that it was holding back from launching airstrikes to avoid destroying the airport.

<a id="event-2023-04-17-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Further sites of illicit soft plastic storage are found in Sydney after the collapse of commercial plastic recycler REDcycle. After taking $20 million from Coles and Woolworths to recycle soft plastics at 2,000 locations, the company instead stored 12,000 tonnes of plastics at more than 44 locations across Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<https://www.9news.com.au/national/supermarket-news-woolworths-plastic-shopping-bag-pile-discovered-from-failed-recycling-scheme/74e29291-4ee2-4948-b716-e5085f8a9167>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2023/apr/10/more-stockpiles-of-soft-plastics-from-failed-redcycle-recycling-scheme-uncovered>).

Source citations (as archived): [La Capital](<https://www.lacapital.com.ar/la-ciudad/ante-el-tercer-caso-fatal-dengue-santa-fe-salud-pide-no-subestimar-los-sintomas-n10058597.html>); [Infobae](<https://www.infobae.com/salud/2023/04/17/confirmaron-dos-muertes-por-dengue-en-caba-y-suman-35-las-victimas-fatales-en-todo-el-pais/>).

Context: Post-election lawsuits related to the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Fox News and Dominion Voting Systems reach a US$787.5 million settlement in the defamation lawsuit, which was initially filed against the network in March 2021 for spreading false claims about the company regarding the 2020 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Forbes](<https://www.forbes.com/sites/alisondurkee/2023/04/18/fox-news-settles-dominion-defamation-case-for-7875-million-dominion-lawyer-says/?sh=7dac07541509>).

<a id="event-2023-04-18-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four people are severely injured in a stabbing attack at a gym in Duisburg, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/gym-attack-germany-duisburg-casualties-b1075007.html>).

### 2023-04-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360230916](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20April%2019&oldid=1360230916>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-2"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

**Archived source account.** Germany announces the suspension of its attempt to rescue 150 German citizens from Khartoum.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/04/19/world/africa/japan-evacuations-sudan.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/germany-forced-halt-evacuation-mission-sudan-spiegel-2023-04-19/>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-4"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Sudanese refugee crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Sudanese civilians cross the closed border with Chad as refugees and are detained, according to Chadian Defence Minister Daoud Yaya Brahim. Brahim also states that the Chad National Army detained and disarmed a contingent of 320 Sudanese troops who crossed the border.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/africa/hundreds-of-sudanese-troops-flee-to-chad-as-fighting-rages-67223>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/chad-disarmed-sudanese-contingent-which-entered-its-territory-monday-defence-2023-04-19/>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-6"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Evacuation of foreign nationals during the Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom, Germany, and Japan urge their citizens to seek shelter, hide, or evacuate due to ongoing fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/sudan-ceasefire-in-tatters-as-fighting-continues-around-khartoum-12861042>); [The Print India](<https://theprint.in/world/germany-forced-to-halt-evacuation-mission-from-sudan-spiegel/1527675/>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-7"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Evacuation of foreign nationals during the Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** Japanese Chief Cabinet Secretary Hirokazu Matsuno says that Japan will send a Self-Defense Forces aircraft to evacuate 60 Japanese nationals from Sudan.

Source citations (as archived): [Asahi Shimbun](<https://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14889095>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-8"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** Satellite imagery reveals that at least one Egyptian Air Force MiG-29 was destroyed at an airbase in Merowe, with at least two others heavily damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [The Drive](<https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/egyptian-mig-29s-destroyed-in-sudan>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-0-10"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and several others are reported missing after jihadists ambush a Malian government delegation near Nara, Koulikoro Region, Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [Barron's](<https://www.barrons.com/news/four-dead-in-attack-on-mali-govt-convoy-officials-4c28b4f4>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-04-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Canadian federal worker strike.

**Archived source account.** Over 155,000 Canadian federal workers go on strike after the Public Service Alliance of Canada failed to reach an agreement with the government over pay raises and remote work.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-65325863>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-04-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Sanaa crowd crush.

**Archived source account.** At least 90 people are killed and 322 others are injured in a crowd crush in Sanaa, Yemen during a charity event.

Source citations (as archived): [Egypt Independent](<https://egyptindependent.com/90-people-killed-more-than-300-injured-in-sanaa-stampede>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-04-19-3-1"></a>

Context: List of heat waves.

**Archived source account.** A heatwave in Asia leads to deaths and school closures in India, and record-breaking temperatures in other countries. Luang Prabang, Laos, recorded a temperature of 42.7 C, while Tak, Thailand, recorded a temperature of 44.6 C.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/weather/2023/apr/19/severe-heatwave-asia-deaths-schools-close-india-china>).

<a id="event-2023-04-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report by the United Nations Population Fund estimates that India will surpass China as the most populous country in the world by the middle of this year.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/india-overtakes-china-worlds-most-populous-country-rcna80364>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-04-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Bulgaria–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Bulgaria temporarily bans the import of grain from Ukraine, except for those in transit, following similar decisions made by Poland, Hungary, and Slovakia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-grains-bulgaria-idAFL8N36M2G7>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-04-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Costa Rica.

**Archived source account.** President Rodrigo Chaves orders a series of measures to fight increasing crime in Costa Rica, including the deployment of more police, tougher juvenile laws, extradition of foreign criminals, and restrictions on the sale of ammunition.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rica-president-gets-tougher-security-crime-soars-2023-04-19/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-04-19-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Brazilian Congress attack.

**Archived source account.** Secretary of Institutional Security of Brazil Marco Edson Gonçalves Dias resigns over his presence at the presidential palace during the attack. He is replaced by Ricardo Cappelli.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/top-security-adviser-brazils-president-abruptly-resigns-2023-04-19/>).

### 2023-04-20

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Khartoum.

<a id="event-2023-04-20-0-5"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Evacuation of foreign nationals during the Sudanese civil war.

<a id="event-2023-04-20-0-7"></a>

<a id="event-2023-04-20-0-11"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** An Iranian Navy commander claims on state television that the Iranian Navy forced a U.S. submarine to surface as it transited the Strait of Hormuz and that the submarine violated Iranian territorial waters. The U.S. denies the Iranian claims.

Source citations (as archived): [Radiofarda](<https://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-submarine-surface-gulf/32372099.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-04-20-2-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/lawyers-peruvian-ex-president-toledo-try-block-extradition-us-federal-court-2023-04-20/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-04-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Governor of Krasnoyarsk Krai Aleksandr Uss resigns after being offered a position in the federal government. Russian President Vladimir Putin invites Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kotyukov to assume the post of acting governor.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<https://tass.ru/politika/17572713>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-04-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Solar eclipse of April 20, 2023.

**Archived source account.** A hybrid solar eclipse occurs across the South Pacific in Australia, East Timor, and Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/04/20/world/australia/solar-eclipse.html>); [People](<https://people.com/human-interest/hybrid-solar-eclipse-2023-everything-to-know/>).

<a id="event-2023-04-20-4-3"></a>

Context: SpaceX Starship orbital test flight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX launches the first test flight of Starship, the largest and most powerful launch vehicle to ever fly, from Starbase in South Texas. The vehicle successfully launched but lost control and the flight was explosively terminated four minutes after liftoff.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/live/2023/04/20/science/spacex-launch-starship-rocket>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-65334810>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-04-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Anglican realignment.

**Archived source account.** Leaders of the Global Fellowship of Confessing Anglicans, a communion of conservative Anglican churches representing approximately 85% of the global Anglican population, reject the leadership of Archbishop of Canterbury Justin Welby as the head of global Anglicanism over his stance on same-sex marriage.

<a id="event-2023-04-21-1-2"></a>
