The ship, which was carrying over 1,000 prisoners of war, including 850 Australian POWs, represented the largest loss of life for the Australian armed forces during the Second World War.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/04/21/asia/montevideo-maru-found-south-china-sea-intl-hnk/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-04-21-4-2"></a>

Diab was tried in absentia and he remains in Canada under the request of arrest and extradition from French authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/apr/21/canadian-professor-convicted-in-absentia-of-1980-paris-synagogue-bombing>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/21/uk-deputy-prime-minister-dominic-raab-accused-of-bullying-quits>).

<a id="event-2023-04-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Odebrecht scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Peruvian President Alejandro Toledo is extradited from the United States and is taken to prison on charges related to money laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-toledo-returns-home-join-two-other-former-heads-state-jail-2023-04-23/>).

<a id="event-2023-04-23-3-5"></a>

Context: Malindi cult.

**Archived source account.** Forty-seven members of the Good News International Church are found dead from suspected starvation in Malindi, Kilifi County, Kenya.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-04-23-4-2"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 North Kosovo crisis / 2023 Kosovan local elections.

**Archived source account.** In North Kosovo, heads of four municipalities are elected amid a boycott by Serbian parties and a record low turnout of 3.5%. All four elected mayors are ethnic Albanians, although there is a dominant Serb population in the municipalities.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-serbs-special-elections-boycott/32375661.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-04-23-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom launches its UK Emergency Alert System, sending a test emergency population warning to all 4G and 5G mobile phones for the first time. Many people do not receive the alert, particularly users of the Three mobile network. The Cabinet Office acknowledges that the emergency alert did not reach some people, saying that it is "reviewing the test".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-65367282>).

### 2023-05-01

Ukrainian forces say that they shot down 15 of 18 missiles launched by Russia.

### 2023-05-16

### 2023-05-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1180647469](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20May%2017&oldid=1180647469>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-05-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces shell Ukrainian-held areas of Kherson Oblast, killing at least five civilians, including a child, while 17 others are reportedly injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65630018>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-05-17-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed in Forlì–Cesena, Ravenna and Bologna, and 20,000 are evacuated during heavy floods in the region of Emilia-Romagna, Italy. Twenty-three rivers have overflowed their banks across the region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/italy-floods-drought-59db3225a5d4b170a1cb03c0ab40b000>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-1-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods.

**Archived source account.** The 2023 Emilia Romagna Grand Prix, which was scheduled to be held at the Autodromo Internazionale Enzo e Dino Ferrari in Imola from May 19–21, is cancelled because of the floods.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1/65621373>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-1-4"></a>

Context: Lu Peng Yuan Yu sinking.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese government reports that the fishing vessel Lu Peng Yuan Yu 028 capsized in the central Indian Ocean on Tuesday. China and other countries are conducting search operations for 39 sailors, including Chinese, Indonesian, and Filipino nationals.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/rcna84808>); [DW](<https://dw.com/en/china-39-missing-after-boat-capsizes-in-indian-ocean/a-65651314>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-05-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to the World Meteorological Organization, the global temperature will temporarily pass the threshold of 1.5 °C above preindustrial levels, with a likelihood of 66%, by the year 2027, due to a combination of climate change and El Niño.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-65602293>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-05-17-3-1"></a>

Context: France–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** The French Senate votes to recognize the 1932 Holodomor famine as a "genocide" of Ukrainians.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax](<https://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/910843.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/29/french-mps-recognise-ukraine-soviet-era-famine-as-genocide>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian president Vladimir Putin signs an investment program deal that will make an investment of 1.6 billion euros in Iranian railroad projects, which are expected to begin operation within 48 months.

Source citations (as archived): [Tasnim](<https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2023/05/17/2896207/iran-russia-sign-deal-on-major-railroad-project>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-4-2"></a>

Context: Censorship of TikTok, Restrictions on TikTok in the United States / Montana Assembly Bill 419.

**Archived source account.** Montana Governor Greg Gianforte signs a bill banning TikTok, making Montana the first U.S. state to ban the Chinese-owned social media app.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/montana-governor-signs-bill-banning-tiktok-state-2023-05-17/>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-4-4"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** A court in Thailand sentences the former mayor of Wang Wiset district to death for the murder of an activist in May 2021. The hitman received a sentence of life imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Thaiger](<https://thethaiger.com/hot-news/crime/mayor-sentenced-to-death-over-land-activists-murder-in-thailand>).

<a id="event-2023-05-17-4-6"></a>

Context: Siege of Nueva Concepción.

**Archived source account.** Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele deploys 5,000 soldiers and 500 police officers to the northwestern town of Nueva Concepción in order to arrest suspects in connection with the killing of a policeman on Tuesday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/el-salvador-forces-surround-town-north-after-police-killing-2023-05-17/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-05-17-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Ecuadorian political crisis.

**Archived source account.** Amid ongoing impeachment proceedings, Ecuadorian president Guillermo Lasso uses the muerte cruzada provision of the Constitution to dissolve the National Assembly. Fresh presidential and legislative elections will be held within 97 days, during which time Lasso will be able to rule by decree.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-65624035>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-06-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine / Wagner Group rebellion.

<a id="event-2023-06-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian invasion of Ukraine / Wagner Group rebellion.

The FSB begins a mutiny investigation into Yevgeny Prigozhin.

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1165733607](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20July%2010&oldid=1165733607>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-07-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces strike a residential area in Orikhiv, Zaporizhzhia Oblast, killing seven civilians and injuring 11 others, according to Governor Yuriy Malashko.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/four-civilians-killed-11-wounded-russia-strikes-zaporizhzhia-town-ukraine-2023-07-10/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian military commissariats attacks.

**Archived source account.** Stanislav Rzhitsky, deputy chief in charge of military mobilization in the Russian city of Krasnodar and commander of the Russian Navy submarine B-265 Krasnodar, is shot dead near the city's sports complex.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/11/senior-russian-draft-officer-shot-dead-while-running-in-park>); [Reuters](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-749527>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-07-10-1-1"></a>

Context: European Union–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission and the U.S. government sign a new data communication agreement aimed at resolving legal uncertainties that European and American companies face when transferring personal data. However, non-profit organization NOYB plans to challenge the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/eu-announces-new-us-data-transfer-pact-challenge-ahead-2023-07-10/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-07-10-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain's Maritime Safety and Rescue Society rescues 86 people from a pirogue off the Canary Islands after human rights defender Helena Maleno reports that three boats carrying around 300 people from Senegal have gone missing since June.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.voanews.com/a/spain-rescues-86-people-near-canary-islands-but-scores-of-migrants-from-senegal-remain-missing-/7175561.html>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and three others are reported missing after heavy rains trigger landslides in Kyushu and Chūgoku, Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/11/heaviest-rain-ever-causes-deadly-floods-and-landslides-in-japan>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and six others are injured when a building catches fire in Leishan County, Guizhou, China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/video/2023/jul/10/massive-fire-tears-through-buildings-in-chinas-guizhou-province-video>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-07-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Effects of climate change.

**Archived source account.** The World Meteorological Organization reports that the Earth experienced its hottest week on record at the beginning of July, attributing the unprecedented temperatures to climate change and the early stages of El Niño.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/science-environment/20230710-last-week-the-hottest-worldwide-on-record-un>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-3-2"></a>

Context: Effects of climate change.

**Archived source account.** In a study published in the medical journal Nature Medicine, researchers from the Barcelona Centre for International Health Research and Inserm estimate that Europe's record heat waves in 2022 resulted in 61,672 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/europe-spain-germany-heatwave-deaths-summer-2022-8e4d8b68d05405605cd2885abed83c74>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-3-4"></a>

Context: Volcanism of Iceland.

**Archived source account.** Icelandic volcano Litli-Hrútur begins erupting.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/video/new-drone-footage-shows-lava-erupting-icelands-litli-hrutur-volcano-2977767/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-07-10-4-2"></a>

Context: Enlargement of NATO / Sweden–NATO relations.

**Archived source account.** Turkish president Recep Tayyip Erdoğan agrees to send Sweden's NATO accession protocol to the Grand National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/nato-turkey-sweden-vilnius-summit-erdogan-stoltenberg-21db7e9be05074d5b0f053b488974a23>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-4-4"></a>

Context: China–Solomon Islands relations.

**Archived source account.** China and the Solomon Islands sign a cooperation agreement between the People's Police and the Royal Solomon Islands Police Force during Prime Minister Manasseh Sogavare's official visit to Beijing in an effort to strengthen their "comprehensive strategic partnership".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-solomon-islands-agree-strategic-partnership-2023-07-10/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-4-6"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea threatens to shoot down any U.S. reconnaissance aircraft breaching its airspace following U.S. plans to deploy a ballistic missile submarine near Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230710-north-korea-threatens-to-shoot-down-us-spy-planes-violating-its-airspace>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-4-8"></a>

Context: Iran and weapons of mass destruction, Nuclear program of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Office of the Director of National Intelligence says that Iran is not developing a nuclear weapon. However, it also warns that Iran has ramped up activities that could help develop one.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-intelligence-b506d130e474c00f6bd653d3d5a8d31a>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-07-10-5-1"></a>

Context: School attacks in China.

**Archived source account.** Six people, including three children, are killed and another person is injured in a mass stabbing at a kindergarten in Lianjiang, Guangdong. The suspect is detained by the police.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/3-kids-among-6-dead-in-stabbing-at-kindergarten-in-china-attacker-held-2404268-2023-07-10>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** German businessman Hans Peter Walter Mack, 62, suspected of running a child sex trafficking ring in Thailand, is found mutilated with a chainsaw in a freezer in Pattaya.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<https://metro.co.uk/2023/07/11/thailand-suspected-child-sex-offender-found-dismembered-in-freezer-19108657/?ico=just-in_article_must-read>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-07-10-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Dutch general election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Mark Rutte announces his retirement from politics following the collapse of his cabinet.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/rutte-netherlands-migration-government-90b8716de33aabfad205874f69073b9c>).

<a id="event-2023-07-10-6-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Uzbek presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Uzbek authorities announce that incumbent president Shavkat Mirziyoyev has been re-elected with 87.1% of the votes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/uzbek-leader-re-elected-seven-year-term-snap-election-2023-07-10/>).

### 2023-07-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1221057691](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20July%2011&oldid=1221057691>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-07-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive.

**Archived source account.** Russian Lieutenant General Oleg Tsokov is reportedly killed by a missile strike near Berdiansk, Zaporizhzhia Oblast.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-11-23/h_1c3b305e5bc12343bd24e8fe6954bb74>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-0-4"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Suspected drug cartel members set off bombs targeting police officers in Tlajomulco de Zúñiga, Jalisco, Mexico, killing six people (four officers and two civilians) and injuring 12 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/explosives-attack-kills-three-mexican-security-officials-2023-07-12/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-07-11-1-1"></a>

Context: Proposed acquisition of Activision Blizzard by Microsoft.

**Archived source account.** United States judge Jacqueline Scott Corley approves technology company Microsoft's $69 billion acquisition of video game publisher Activision Blizzard, the largest video game acquisition in history, dismissing the Federal Trade Commission's antitrust injunction request.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/us-judge-rules-microsoft-deal-buy-activision-can-go-forward-2023-07-11/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-07-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Manang Air helicopter touring the Himalayas crashes near Solukhumbu, Koshi Province, Nepal, killing all six on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/helicopter-with-six-people-board-goes-missing-nepal-2023-07-11/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 11 others are injured when an elevated road collapses in Bangkok, Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-elevated-road-collapse-bangkok-69927d6314dc9f6a4707d14c41da0472>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Montpelier, Vermont, United States, receives extensive flooding after the Wrightsville Dam exceeds capacity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/vermont-reservoir-threatens-overflow-floods-lash-state-capital-2023-07-11/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-07-11-3-2"></a>

Context: Nagorno-Karabakh conflict / Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Azerbaijan's State Border Service temporarily closes the Lachin corridor, the only road between Armenia and the disputed Nagorno-Karabakh region, alleging smuggling by the Armenian Red Cross Society.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/07/11/Azerbaijan-halts-transport-passage-between-Armenia-Karabakh-Border-guards->).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-3-4"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Hong Kong, Foreign relations of Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Hong Kong government threatens to ban marine products from multiple prefectures if Japan pursues its plan to discharge treated radioactive waste water from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant into the Pacific Ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hong-kong-fukushima-wastewater-seafood-e2f09b4e610e7543e0e3ea3a16fb541e>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-3-6"></a>

Context: Australia–Vietnam relations.

**Archived source account.** The Vietnamese government releases Australian democracy activist Chau Van Kham from a 12-year prison sentence on terrorism charges following an appeal by Australian prime minister Anthony Albanese.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/australia-vietnam-chau-van-kham-democracy-3819e0582825632bea9089e759793c9b>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-07-11-4-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court overturns the restroom use restrictions that the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry imposed on a trans woman employee, marking the court's first ruling on LGBT working conditions.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/japan-supreme-court-transgender-restroom-restriction-8db97bcc696ab8abd9e7c396402d7ea8>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and four others are injured during a mass shooting at a home in Kwanobuhle, Eastern Cape, South Africa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-african-police-hunt-murder-suspects-after-eastern-cape-shooting-2023-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-11-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two German nationals are arrested and charged in the dismemberment death of German businessman Hans Peter Walter Mack in Pattaya, Thailand with a Pakistani-Thai national on the run. Two other German nationals are detained as suspects in relation to the case.

Source citations (as archived): [(The Star (Malaysia)](<https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2023/07/12/three-arrested-over-murder-of-german-businessman-in-thailand>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-07-11-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thai prime minister Prayut Chan-o-cha announces his retirement from political office.

Source citations (as archived): [CNA](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/thailand-caretaker-pm-ex-coup-leader-prayut-quit-politics-3620891>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-07-11-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Anthropocene Working Group identifies Crawford Lake near Milton, Ontario, Canada, as the origin of the proposed Anthropocene epoch due to its varves which provide a comprehensive geologic record of recent environmental change.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://tribune.net.ph/2023/07/12/canadian-lake-ground-zero-for-anthropocene-epoch/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-07-11-7-1"></a>

Context: Testosterone regulations in women's athletics.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Human Rights rules in favor of South African runner Caster Semenya, stating that Semenya's previous appeals against World Athletics' testosterone regulations were inadequately reviewed, potentially enabling her to recontest these rules due to her hyperandrogenism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/sports/athletics/semenya-wins-appeal-over-human-rights-violations-2023-07-11/>).

### 2023-07-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1216875727](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20July%2012&oldid=1216875727>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-07-12-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces strike a residential area in Zaporizhzhia, injuring 18 civilians, including six children.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-keeps-air-strikes-kyiv-nato-meets-2023-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** An 81-year-old man is killed and his wife is injured due to Russian shelling in Kherson.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/13/russia-ukraine-war-at-a-glance-what-we-know-on-day-505-of-the-invasion>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-0-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Lebanese conflict.

**Archived source account.** Three Hezbollah members are injured by Israeli strikes near the Blue Line with the Israel Defense Forces accusing Hezbollah of attempting to destroy the border barrier.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230712-israeli-fire-wounds-hezbollah-members-near-lebanon-israel-border-security-source>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-0-7"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Nine soldiers, five Tehreek-e-Jihad Pakistan gunmen, and a civilian passerby are killed in a shootout at a security checkpoint in Zhob, Balochistan, Pakistan. Five other soldiers are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-militants-attack-security-forces-4609bc60ace91501d0567df370f3ab4f>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-07-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines' film review board requests that American film distributor Warner Bros. Pictures censor a scene in the upcoming film Barbie that includes a map displaying the internationally contested nine-dash line in the South China Sea before releasing the film in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66173164>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a study published in PLOS One, researchers identify subtle modifications to ancient Egyptian funerary artworks, such as the repositioning of Ramesses II's sceptre and changes in the pigmentation used for skin color, using portable imaging and chemical analysis techniques. These findings suggest a higher degree of creativity among ancient Egyptian artists than was previously recognized.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/13/world/americas-emea/ancient-egyptian-artists-altered-their-work-study-shows/1900421>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-07-12-2-1"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 Pakistani economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** The International Monetary Fund approves a US$3 billion bailout deal for Pakistan to avert its potential debt defaults and regain economic stability.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-imf-bailout-approved-81bc70d9d707534ae3ffbba9030e8add>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-2-3"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 food crises.

**Archived source account.** India's food ministry reports a 341% surge in tomato prices from INR 24.68 (US$0.30) to INR 108.92 ($1.33) per kilogram, attributed to extreme weather and the tomato mosaic virus affecting major tomato-producing states. Farmers have reported incidents of tomato theft in response to the report.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2023/07/13/indias-tomato-prices-surge-over-300percent-prompting-thieves-and-turmoil.html>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-2-5"></a>

Context: Tourism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Bali announces the imposition of a IDR 150,000 (US$10) tourist tax for foreign visitors from 2024, aiming to preserve the island's culture and environment.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2336521/world>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-07-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2023.

**Archived source account.** A series of tornadoes strike Chicago, Illinois, United States, prompting complete ground stops at O'Hare and Midway International Airports.

Source citations (as archived): [WFLD-TV](<https://www.fox32chicago.com/news/chicago-flights-canceled-severe-weather-impacting-travel>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and 14 others are injured when a Greyhound passenger bus crashes into three parked trucks at a rest area off Interstate 70 in Madison County, Illinois, U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/jul/12/greyhound-bus-crash-illinois>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Iran summons the Russian ambassador over a joint statement issued by Russia and the Gulf Cooperation Council over three islands disputed by the United Arab Emirates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/iran-summons-russian-ambassador-over-statement-three-islands-state-media-2023-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-3"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations, North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires a Hwasong-18 intercontinental ballistic missile into waters near Japan. This comes a day after North Korea threatened the United States, claiming that an American spy plane entered the country's exclusive economic zone multiple times on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-missile-launch-ced1ccd42f6e9d3aafdd02f3e77572fb>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/11/asia/north-korea-missile-test-intl-hnk-ml/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-5"></a>

Context: Myanmar–Thailand relations, Myanmar civil war.

**Archived source account.** Thai deputy prime minister and foreign minister Don Pramudwinai announces that he visited jailed Myanmar democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi last week, becoming the first known foreign representative to meet with the deposed state counsellor since the 2021 coup d'état.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/aung-san-suu-kyi-thai-fm-says-he-met-ousted-myanmar-leader-3623241>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-7"></a>

Context: 2023 Vilnius summit.

**Archived source account.** At the NATO summit in Vilnius, Lithuania, G7 officials announce that they have unveiled an international framework for Ukraine’s long-term security in a effort to boost their defense against Russia and deter them from any future aggression. The measures will include bilateral talks, military hardware, training, intelligence-sharing, and other plans to rebuild the country’s economy.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico EU](<https://www.politico.eu/article/embargo-g7-countries-pledge-long-term-support-to-ukraine/amp/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/sending-message-russia-g7-announce-long-term-security-assurances-ukraine-2023-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-9"></a>

Context: Serbia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States imposes sanctions on Aleksandar Vulin, a top Serbian official considered "Moscow's man".

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://news.yahoo.com/us-imposes-sanctions-top-serbian-172612717.html>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-4-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** UNESCO accepts the U.S. as a member after it withdrew from the organization in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2023/06/30/unesco-accepts-the-us-back-into-the-fold-after-a-five-year-absence>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-07-12-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Singaporean prime minister Lee Hsien Loong places Transport Minister S. Iswaran on an immediate leave of absence amid an ongoing corruption investigation by the Corrupt Practices Investigation Bureau into Iswaran and other individuals.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/singapore-anti-graft-agency-probes-transport-minister-2023-07-12/>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed during protests in Nairobi, Kenya, against tax increases imposed by President William Ruto's government, in which the police have employed tear gas and heightened security measures.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230712-kenya-police-fire-tear-gas-as-protesters-defy-ban>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-07-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2023 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** At the request of the Guatemalan Public Ministry, a judge orders the Supreme Electoral Tribunal to suspend the legal personality of candidate Bernardo Arévalo's Movimiento Semilla party, which went on to the second round of elections on 20 August. The legal measure would leave Arévalo out of the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/13/guatemala-prosecutor-suspends-party-of-anti-corruption-election-candidate>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-6-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2023 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** After several days of delay, the Supreme Electoral Tribunal makes the electoral results official and calls for the second round of elections between Sandra Torres and Bernardo Arévalo.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/guatemalan-tribunal-certifies-election-results-minutes-after-court-101201509>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-6-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2023 Thai general election.

**Archived source account.** Thailand's election commission petitions the Constitutional Court to suspend leading prime ministerial candidate Pita Limjaroenrat, alleging his violation of campaign laws due to prior share ownership in a media company, iTV.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/07/12/thai-electoral-body-recommends-suspension-of-top-candidate-for-prime-minister_6050423_4.html>).

<a id="event-2023-07-12-6-6"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** An ASEAN LGBT event scheduled in Indonesia is relocated to an undisclosed location due to received security threats and anti-LGBT rhetoric from various groups.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/lgbt-event-indonesia-scrapped-after-security-threats-2023-07-12/>).

### 2023-07-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360236163](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20July%2013&oldid=1360236163>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-07-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** A Russian drone attack on Kyiv injures at least two civilians and damages infrastructure.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66184558>).

<a id="event-2023-07-13-0-5"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Geneina.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese Armed Forces shells three RSF-held neighbourhoods in Omdurman, Khartoum State, Sudan, killing at least 18 people and injuring dozens more.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/25/sudan-city-omdurman-attack>).

The suspected killer had been chasing one of the vehicles prior to the accident.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-07-25/man-charged-with-murder-after-triple-fatal-bruce-highway-crash/102642668>).

Authorities confirmed their belief that the crimes are related.

Context: Capital punishment in Ghana.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Ghana votes to formally abolish the death penalty, becoming the latest African nation to end the punishment. The 176 prisoners currently on death row in Ghanian prisons will now have their sentences changed to life imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2023/07/25/1189899320/an-american-becomes-the-youngest-to-debut-in-the-womens-world-cup-for-south-kore>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Russia launches cruise missiles at Kyiv Oblast, Khmelnytskyi Oblast, and Kirovohrad Oblast in Ukraine. Air Force Commander Mykola Oleschuk says that 36 targets, including three Kalibr and 33 Kh-101/Kh-55 cruise missiles were shot down.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-strike-targets-three-ukrainian-regions-air-force-2023-07-26/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/26/soldiers-holding-niger-president-inside-palace-security-sources>).

<a id="event-2023-07-26-0-5"></a>

Context: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Soldiers announce on state television that President Mohamed Bazoum has been removed from power. The country's borders are closed and a nationwide curfew is declared.

Source citations (as archived): [The Examiner](<https://www.examiner.com.au/story/8285246/niger-president-bazoum-has-been-removed-soldiers-say/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/26/armed-troops-blockade-presidential-palace-in-niger-mohamed-bazoum>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-07-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / Bombing of Kryvyi Rih.

<a id="event-2023-07-31-0-5"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN International](<https://edition.cnn.com/europe/live-news/russia-ukraine-war-news-07-31-23/h_88d2b755dc211b3347ece2dd94f084f7>).

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State-KP claims responsibility for yesterday's suicide bombing at a Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F) rally in Khar, Bajaur District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, which killed 54 people and injured around 200 others.

<a id="event-2023-07-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Twelve FARC dissidents and a soldier are killed during a shootout in a mountainous region in Cauca Department.

<a id="event-2023-07-31-0-11"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Seven Clan del Golfo members are killed and four arrested after soldiers stormed one of their camps in Chocó Department.

Source citations (as archived): [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/mundo/latinoamerica/colombia-siete-muertos-y-cuatro-heridos-en-operaciones-contra-el-clan-del-golfo-choco-carlos-alberto-serrano-medio-baudo-rio-purricha-oscar-leonel-murillo-carlos-camargo-ultimas-noticia/>).

Context: 2023 Ain al-Hilweh clashes.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-07-31-1-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/travel/unesco-venice-heritage-danger-list/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-07-31-2-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état / France–Niger relations.

**Archived source account.** Niger's military junta accuses France of wanting to intervene by force to reinstate ousted president Mohamed Bazoum, a day after ECOWAS gave an ultimatum for Bazoum's reinstatement. The French foreign ministry denies the accusation.

<a id="event-2023-07-31-2-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Nigerien coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** The governments of Burkina Faso and Mali issue a joint statement saying that any military intervention in Niger to overthrow the new military junta will be considered a "declaration of war" against both countries.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/niger-military-intervention-would-be-declaration-of-war-on-burkina-faso-and-mali-joint-statement-d8285fae>).

<a id="event-2023-07-31-2-6"></a>

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations / Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom imposes sanctions on the judges and officials involved in the prosecution of activist Vladimir Kara-Murza, who lost the appeal of his 25-year sentence for treason.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/uk-sanctions-russian-judges-officials-involved-kara-murza-trial-2023-07-31/>).

Context: 2023 Senegalese protests.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Justice charges detained opposition leader and Ziguinchor mayor Ousmane Sonko with fomenting insurrection, undermining state security, and criminal association with a terrorist body.

Context: Myanmar civil war, Myanmar protests.

**Archived source account.** Acting President Myint Swe announces the National Defence and Security Council's extension of the country's state of emergency by six months, likely delaying the general election that was previously pledged to be held by August, saying that the country's situation has "not returned to normalcy yet".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/31/world/myanmar-junta-extends-state-of-emergency-delaying-polls/1903277>).

<a id="event-2023-07-31-3-8"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [TNN](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/rpf-jawan-shoots-four-dead-inside-jaipur-mumbai-train/articleshow/102260189.cms?from=mdr>).

Context: Murder of Agnes Wanjiru.

**Archived source account.** Kenya launches an inquiry into British Army Training Unit Kenya, amid allegations of murder, sexual abuse, and damage to land near the base.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2023/aug/14/kenya-launches-inquiry-into-claims-of-abuse-by-british-soldiers-at-training-unit>).

Context: Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors announce that police are investigating bomb threats at the Eiffel Tower in Paris that resulted in two evacuations on Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/philadelphia/news/fbi-in-philadelphia-17-year-old-terrorism-arrest/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-14-4-9"></a>

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-08-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Brazil blackout.

**Archived source account.** Brazil is affected by a nationwide blackout, with all of the states connected to the national energy system impacted. The state of Roraima is unaffected as it has its own energy system. The cause of the outage is still unknown.

Source citations (as archived): [The Brazilian Report](<https://brazilian.report/liveblog/politics-insider/2023/08/15/mystery-power-outage/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-15-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of China.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese national statistics office announces that retail sales increased by 2.5% year on year in July, while industrial production increased by 3.7% and unemployment increased to 5.3%. However, further releases of statistics on age-specific data will be suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/china-stops-releasing-youth-jobs-data-economic-figures-disappoint-3699656>).

<a id="event-2023-08-15-1-4"></a>

Context: Economy of China.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese central bank lowers the medium-term lending facility rate, which is the interest rate on one-year loans to financial institutions, to 2.5%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/china-economy-rates/china-central-bank-cuts-rates-for-second-time-in-three-months-to-support-economy-idUSKBN2ZQ02R>).

<a id="event-2023-08-15-1-6"></a>

Context: Economy of Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Kenya's government debt surges to a record KSh 10.1 trillion (US$70.75 billion), surpassing its KSh 10 trillion debt limit, attributed to external debt and currency fluctuations. President William Ruto's response to the country's financial crisis has been met with months of civil disorder.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://amp.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20230816-kenya-s-debt-rises-to-historic-high-treasury>).

<a id="event-2023-08-15-1-8"></a>

Context: Sri Lankan economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka permits the importation of buses and trucks, reversing a part of its 2020 vehicle import ban initiated due to foreign exchange shortages, while bans on cars, motorcycles, and three-wheeled motor scooters persist pending improved foreign reserves.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.nst.com.my/world/world/2023/08/943439/sri-lanka-lifts-import-ban-buses-trucks>).

**Archived source account.** Trading of Evergrande resumes on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange after a 17-month suspension with the company confirming its compliance with financial information disclosure and listing regulations.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.philstar.com/business/2023/08/28/2292014/china-developer-evergrande-resumes-trading-hong-kong>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-08-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and two others are injured in a building collapse in Ismailia, Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/507352/Egypt/Urban--Transport/Three-people-killed,-two-injured-in-building-colla.aspx>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-08-28-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran says it has reached an agreement with Iraq to disarm and relocate Kurdish rebels in northern Iraq and shut down bases run by the groups in the semi-autonomous region.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/28/iran-says-deal-agreed-with-iraq-for-disarming-relocation-of-kurdish-rebels>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-08-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Iraq announces the execution by hanging of three members of the Islamic State for the 2016 Karrada bombing which killed hundreds of people.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/iraq-hangs-3-for-is-claimed-blast-that-killed-hundreds-ceea2243>).

<a id="event-2023-08-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Polish railway cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** Poland arrests sixteen people on suspicion of spying for Russia in relation to a cyberattack on Polish railways.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/08/28/poland-railway-disruptions-arrest/ff7847d8-45d2-11ee-b76b-0b6e5e92090d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2023-08-28-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Chilean court upholds the prison sentences ranging from eight to 25 years for seven former soldiers involved in the 1973 murder of singer Víctor Jara, which occurred after the coup d'état that ushered in Augusto Pinochet's dictatorship.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/chilean-court-sends-ex-soldiers-aged-73-85-jail-over-decades-old-murder-3731026>).

<a id="event-2023-08-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Registry of Citizens of the Supreme Electoral Tribunal suspends the legal personality of Movimiento Semilla, the party of President-elect Bernardo Arévalo.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/registro-de-ciudadanos-suspende-provisionalmente-la-inscripcion-de-la-personalidad-juridica-del-partido-movimiento-semilla-breaking/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-28-5-3"></a>

Context: 2024 Taiwanese presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Foxconn founder Terry Gou announces that he will run as an independent in next year's presidential election on a platform of restoration of positive Cross-Strait relations and closer business ties.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/28/foxconn-billionaire-terry-gou-announces-taiwan-presidential-bid>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-08-28-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.

**Archived source account.** Cape Verde and South Sudan, who both make their World Cup debut, score their first-ever wins at the tournament. After first-round losses to Georgia and Puerto Rico, the African teams defeat Venezuela and China.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/fiba-basketball-world-cup-africa-south-sudan-cape-verde-44c0fdbb0dfbc22f074eaffef2a12d26>).

### 2023-08-29

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-08-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Ethiopian civil conflict / War in Amhara.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations reports that at least 183 people have been killed during recent clashes between Fano militiamen and security forces in Amhara Region, Ethiopia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/fighting-ethiopias-amhara-kills-least-183-un-says-2023-08-29/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022–2023 western Russia attacks.

**Archived source account.** At least four Ilyushin Il-76 military transport aircraft in Pskov are damaged in a drone attack on Pskov. Russian authorities say they have shot down eight drones over the Bryansk, Oryol, Ryazan, Kaluga and Moscow oblasts.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/aug/30/drone-strike-in-russian-city-of-pskov-reportedly-damages-heavy-transport-planes>).

<a id="event-2023-08-29-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The government of Kyrgyzstan says 95 wives and children of Islamic State fighters have been repatriated from internment camps in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/30/kyrgyzstan-brings-back-95-isil-wives-children-from-syrian-internment-camps>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-08-29-1-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Idalia.

**Archived source account.** Widespread flooding and power outages are reported as Idalia makes landfall in Cuba.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/idalia-set-slam-floridas-gulf-coast-wednesday-major-hurricane-2023-08-29/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-08-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a study published in the journal Emerging Infectious Diseases, Australian doctors report the removal of an eight-centimeter Ophidascaris robertsi roundworm from the brain of a 64-year-old woman. This is the first documented case of such a parasite in any mammalian brain.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2638095/live-worm-found-in-australian-womans-brain>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister James Marape announces that his country will open its Israeli embassy in Jerusalem.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-08-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Imran Khan arrest attempts.

**Archived source account.** The Islamabad High Court in Pakistan reverses a lower court's three-year imprisonment verdict against former prime minister Imran Khan for graft, while also granting Khan bail.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/imran-khan-pakistan-court-suspends-ex-pm-graft-sentence-3731936>).

<a id="event-2023-08-29-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cyprus police arrest 21 people after violent clashes between refugees and residents of Chloraka village in the west of the island which has a large population of asylum seekers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/29/cyprus-police-arrest-21-people-as-tensions-between-locals-and-migrants-rise>).

<a id="event-2023-08-29-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indonesian police arrest 88 Chinese nationals in Batam, Riau Islands, after receiving a tip from Chinese police, for allegedly operating a cyber extortion scheme involving romance scams targeting victims in China.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230830-indonesia-arrests-88-chinese-nationals-over-love-scams>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-08-29-5-2"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / 2024 Republican Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of Miami Francis Suarez suspends his campaign for President of the United States, becoming the first Republican candidate to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2023/aug/29/francis-suarez-republican-mayor-drops-out>).

### 2023-08-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-08-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / 2023 DRC anti-MONUSCO protests.

**Archived source account.** At least 48 people are killed during a crackdown on anti-United Nations protests in Goma, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Source citations (as archived): [i24 NEWS](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/africa/1693551114-deadly-crackdown-on-anti-un-protest-in-dr-congo-s-east>).

<a id="event-2023-08-30-0-4"></a>

Context: 2023 Gabonese coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Officers of the Gabonese military depose president Ali Bongo and annul the results of the general election in which Bongo was declared the winner. They also dissolve the government and close all borders.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gabonese-military-officers-announce-they-have-seized-power-2023-08-30/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-30-0-7"></a>

<a id="event-2023-08-30-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russia says that its aircraft destroyed four military boats carrying up to 50 members from landing groups of the special forces of Ukraine operating in the Black Sea as well as two Ukrainian military speedboats carrying military personnel east of Snake Island.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/30/russia-claims-ukrainian-special-forces-boats-destroyed-in-black-sea>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-says-its-forces-destroyed-us-made-military-vessel-near-snake-island-2023-08-22/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-30-0-11"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Rojava conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/30/several-killed-in-fighting-between-sdf-and-tribesmen-in-eastern-syria>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-08-30-1-2"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / 2022–2023 Russia–European Union gas dispute.

**Archived source account.** Global Witness reveals that EU countries increased their imports of liquefied natural gas from Russia despite committing to reductions, rising by 40% in 2023, accounting for 22 million cubic meters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/lng-imports-russia-rise-despite-cuts-pipeline-gas-2023-08-30/>).

<a id="event-2023-08-30-1-4"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Economic sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** India asks the United States to release $26m belonging to at least two Indian diamond firms that has been frozen due to alleged trade links with sanctioned Russian diamond mining company Alrosa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/india-asks-us-release-funds-frozen-over-suspected-russia-diamond-link-sources-2023-08-30/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-08-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Idalia makes landfall in the U.S. state of Florida as a category 3 hurricane. Flooding is reported in the Tampa Bay area, including Tampa and other parts of Hillsborough County. Two deaths are reported with both being due to vehicle accidents.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2023/08/30/hurricane-idalia-landfall-florida-live-updates/>); [Spot On Florida](<https://spotonflorida.com/west-central-florida/4803288/hurricane-idalia-flooding-in-tampa-and-hillsborough.html>).

**Archived source account.** The death toll from torrential rains in Tajikistan increase to 21, as flooding, landslides, and mudflows affect towns near Dushanbe.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/toll-from-heavy-rains-in-tajikistan-rises-to-21-d29f1b8a>).

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Russia vetoes a United Nations Security Council resolution to extend targeted sanctions on Mali for one year and maintain a team of UN rapporteurs investigating abuses.

**Archived source account.** Former Colombian National Army General Mario Montoya Uribe is charged for his role in the "false positives" scandal. Montoya is accused of carrying out extrajudicial executions of 130 people.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa Latina](<https://www.laprensalatina.com/jep-charges-former-army-commander-with-false-positives-for-first-time/>).

Context: 2023 Guatemalan general election.

Source citations (as archived): [La Hora](<https://lahora.gt/nacionales/la-hora/2023/08/30/siguen-las-consecuencias-del-resultado-electoral-congreso-desconoce-a-la-bacada-semilla/>).

Context: Censorship of TikTok.

**Archived source account.** Kyrgyzstan's Ministry of Culture, Information, Sports and Youth Policy announces that it will ban the TikTok platform in an effort to protect the health of young children.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-08-30-7-1"></a>

Context: 2023 in volleyball.

**Archived source account.** In an event billed as "Volleyball Day in Nebraska", 92,003 people fill the University of Nebraska's Memorial Stadium for a match between the Nebraska Cornhuskers and Omaha Mavericks, setting a new verified attendance record for a women's sports event.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/college-sports/story/_/id/38294591/nebraska-volleyball-sets-world-record-attendance-women-sporting-event>).

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack / Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack.

## September

### 2023-09-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360222572](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20September%201&oldid=1360222572>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Siege of El Obeid.

**Archived source account.** Sudanese Armed Forces capture El Obeid, pushing the Rapid Support Forces out of the city, although skirmishes continue on the outskirts of the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Dabanga Sudan](<https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/battles-continue-in-sudan-at-least-48-million-people-fled-their-homes>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Deir ez-Zor clashes (2023).

**Archived source account.** Arab tribesmen briefly take control of two villages in Aleppo Governorate in order to support fellow tribesmen fighting the Syrian Democratic Forces in northeast Syria, as the battle enters its third day with at least 45 people killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/1/fighting-between-arab-tribes-and-sdf-spreads-to-northwest-syria>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Nagorno-Karabakh conflict / Armenia–Azerbaijan border crisis.

**Archived source account.** Armenia says that shelling by Azerbaijani forces in the town of Sotk killed four of its soldiers and injured another by striking its positions across the border using drones.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/two-armenian-soldiers-killed-azerbaijani-shelling-defence-ministry-2023-09-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-10"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man is killed and several others are injured, a building is destroyed and ambulances are obstructed and shot at, during a raid by Israeli soldiers in Aqabah, in the occupied West Bank.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/1/palestinian-farmer-killed-in-gunfight-after-israeli-raid-on-west-bank-town>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-12"></a>

Context: Nigerian bandit conflict.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen kill nine people including seven in a mosque in Ikara Local Government Area in Nigeria's Kaduna State as worshippers gathered for prayer. Two other injured people were taken to hospital for treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-seven-worshippers-nigerias-northern-kaduna-state-2023-09-02/>); [Premium Times](<https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/nwest/619223-nine-people-killed-in-kaduna-mosque-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-0-14"></a>

Context: Western Sahara conflict.

**Archived source account.** Five Polisario Front militants, including a leader, are killed during an airstrike by Morocco near Tindouf. The Sahrawi presidency declares three days of mourning.

Source citations (as archived): [Asharq Al-Awsat](<https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/4523701-five-members-polisario-front-killed-moroccan-raid>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-09-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2022–2023 food crises.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines imposes price ceilings on rice in order to counter increasing costs and alleged market manipulation, setting the maximum prices for regular-milled and well-milled rice, at PHP 41 (US$0.72) and PHP 45 ($0.80) per kilogram, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-curbs-rice-prices-inflation-worry-mounts-2023-09-01/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-09-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong raises its typhoon warning signal to level 10, the highest level, as Super Typhoon Saola approaches. Over 880,000 people in the Chinese provinces of Fujian and Guangdong have been evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230901-super-typhoon-saola-sweeps-towards-southern-china-megacities>).

<a id="event-2023-09-01-2-2"></a>

### 2023-09-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1317334738](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20September%206&oldid=1317334738>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict / 2021–2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks.

**Archived source account.** The East African Community announces the extension of a mandate of a regional military force deployed to deal with the low-intensity conflict in the east of the country. Troops were first sent into the region after the resurgence of the M23 rebel group.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/6/east-africa-leaders-extend-regional-troop-mandate-in-dr-congo>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

**Archived source account.** Twelve Pakistani Taliban gunmen and four soldiers are killed in a shootout at a security outpost in the Kalasha Valleys in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/pakistan-clashes-near-afghan-border/7257257.html>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-8"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine / September 2023 Kostiantynivka missile strike.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed and 30 others are injured in a missile strike on a marketplace in Kostiantynivka, Donetsk Oblast Kyiv blamed the attack on Russia, who denied involvement in the attack. An investigation by the New York Times found evidence which suggested a Ukrainian 9M38 missile fired by a mobile Buk antiaircraft vehicle was responsible for the strike.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/09/18/world/europe/ukraine-missile-kostiantynivka-market.html>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-10"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The United States announces a $175 million aid package for Ukraine that includes depleted uranium ammunition for the first time, intended for use with Abrams tanks.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ukraine-war-armor-piercing-rounds-u-s-weapons/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-11"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** British Defence Secretary Grant Shapps confirms reports by Russian officials that a Challenger 2 tank was destroyed in Ukraine, marking the first loss of the model on the battlefield.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/uk-defense-secretary-confirms-challenger-2-tank-destroyed-in-ukraine/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-12"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Russian pilot Maxim Kuzminov, who defected to Ukraine with a MI-8 helicopter, receives a $500,000 reward for defecting.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2023/9/6/russian-pilot-who-defected-to-ukraine-with-helicopter-gets-500000-reward>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-13"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Romanian Ministry of National Defence confirms that debris from a Russian drone has been found on Romanian territory in Tulcea County. Romania denied claims that drones launched by Russia exploded on Romanian territory.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/romania-danube-ukraine-drone-russia-49d7c2f087d19cd0363dc24b8b121f8d>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-16"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / 2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka's government announces that it will appoint a parliamentary committee to investigate allegations made in a Channel 4 report that Sri Lankan intelligence was complicit in the bombings.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/islamic-state-sri-lanka-easter-blasts-b0595ea79ade9c131b0e703c93cdbbe5>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-0-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tajikistan announces that it killed three Jamaat Ansarullah Islamist militants on 29–30 August after the militants crossed the border from Afghanistan to carry out terrorist attacks in Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/tajikistan-kills-three-militants-from-afghanistan-f77112bd>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-09-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Bank of Poland announces significant interest cuts, lowering the reference rate from 6.75% to 6%, simultaneously causing the złoty to lose value against the dollar and the euro.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/business/polands-central-bank-cuts-key-interest-rate-despite-double-digit-inflation/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-09-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Rio Grande do Sul floods.

**Archived source account.** An extratropical cyclone in southern Brazil causes flooding in several cities, killing at least 27 people and leaving more than 1,600 people homeless.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/brazil-storm-floods-disaster-climate-97d946798a4ba1d3ef0269bfcdf3c70c>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-2-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Southeast Europe floods.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people have been killed by floods caused by torrential rain in Bulgaria, Turkey, and Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-66728709>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-09-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in Africa.

**Archived source account.** The African Climate Summit in Nairobi, Kenya, ends with a call for world leaders to implement a global carbon tax on fossil fuels, transport and reforms of global financial systems which leaders say disproportionately disadvantages African nations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/africa-climate-kenya-finance-65a5708b00e204a7c3d2783e81d3e1b6>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** President of Russia Vladimir Putin and President of Turkey Recep Tayyip Erdoğan hold talks in Sochi, Russia, to discuss the revival of the Black Sea Grain Initiative, enabling the passage of grain across the Black Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/04/middleeast/erdogan-putin-meeting-sochi-mime-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-09-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in Mexico.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation decriminalizes abortion nationwide in Mexico, ruling that laws prohibiting the procedure are unconstitutional and violate women’s rights.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-abortion-decriminalize-d87f6edbdf68c2e6c8f5700b3afd15de>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-4-3"></a>

Context: Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. federal court judge rules that Donald Trump is liable for damages in the second defamation case against journalist E. Jean Carroll.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/06/politics/e-jean-carroll-trump-defamation-lawsuit/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-4-5"></a>

Context: Human rights in France.

**Archived source account.** A schoolgirl in Lyon, France, is reportedly sent home for wearing a traditional Japanese kimono as the nation implements a controversial law banning the display of religious symbols in public schools.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/6/french-school-expels-student-for-wearing-a-kimono-lawyer>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-4-7"></a>

Context: Prison escape of Daniel Khalife.

**Archived source account.** British former soldier Daniel Khalife, awaiting trial for terror and explosives offenses, escapes from HM Prison Wandsworth in southwest London, United Kingdom, triggering a nationwide manhunt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66733660>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-09-06-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 in archosaur paleontology.

**Archived source account.** A dinosaur fossil, given the name Fujianvenator, is discovered in Fujian, China. The dinosaur has two legs and two other limbs, possibly wings, thereby giving insight into the evolution of birds.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2489491-dinosaurus-ontdekt-die-nieuw-licht-werpt-op-evolutie-vogels>).

<a id="event-2023-09-06-5-3"></a>

Context: Exploration of the Moon.

**Archived source account.** JAXA launches the Smart Lander for Investigating Moon (SLIM) lunar lander from Tanegashima Space Center. The Japanese mission will aim to become the fifth country to perform a soft landing on the Moon.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/technology/space/japan-launches-rocket-carrying-moon-lander-slim-after-three-delays-2023-09-06/>).

### 2023-09-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355751346](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20September%207&oldid=1355751346>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-09-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in the Sahel / Mali War / September 2023 Mali attacks.

**Archived source account.** Islamist insurgents attack a military camp and a riverboat in northeast Mali. Sixty-four people are killed during the attacks, including 49 civilians and fifteen troops.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-66747884>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/least-49-civilians-15-soldiers-killed-north-east-mali-attacks-interim-government-2023-09-07/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Eastern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian forces enter the deserted villages of Stroivka and Topoli at the Russia–Ukraine border in Kharkiv Oblast. The villages were abandoned by Russia after the 2022 Kharkiv counteroffensive but Ukraine was previously unable to enter the villages due to the presence of mines in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Independent](<https://kyivindependent.com/border-guards-raise-flags-in-kharkiv-oblast-gray-zone-settlements-near-russian-border/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-0-8"></a>

Context: Anglophone Crisis.

**Archived source account.** Three civilians are killed when armed separatists attack vehicles in Muea, Southwest Region, Cameroon. Armed militants stopped cars, shot at passengers and set vehicles on fire during the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/cameroon-militants-set-cars-fire-shoot-passengers-village-attack-2023-09-07/>); [Africanews](<https://www.africanews.com/2023/09/07/cameroon-at-least-three-killed-in-attack-blamed-on-separatist-rebels/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-0-10"></a>

Context: Ethnic violence in South Sudan.

**Archived source account.** Two farmers are killed and one is injured after an attack by unknown armed men in Eastern Equatoria, South Sudan. The victims were returning home when the attack occurred.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Tamazuj](<https://www.radiotamazuj.org/en/news/article/e-equatoria-2-killed-1-injured-in-imehejek-revenge-attack>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-0-12"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war.

**Archived source account.** Six civilians are shot dead on a fronton court near the downtown of Guadalupe, Zacatecas. Hours later other armed attacks leave two more people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [El Sol de Zacatecas](<https://www.elsoldezacatecas.com.mx/local/municipios/de-entre-22-y-57-anos-las-edades-de-las-victimas-de-masacre-en-guadalupe-zacatecas-10662069.html>); [El Sol de Zacatecas](<https://www.elsoldezacatecas.com.mx/local/matan-a-una-mujer-y-un-hombre-en-ataques-armados-en-guadalupe-10657209.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** China bans the use of iPhones for government officials resulting in the market value of Apple Inc. stock declining by $200 billion in the past two days.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/06/tech/china-government-official-iphone-ban/index.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-09-07/apple-poised-to-shed-194-billion-as-china-broadens-iphone-ban?srnd=premium#xj4y7vzkg>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-09-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Southeast Europe floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the floods in Turkey, Bulgaria, and Greece increases to 15 after five more people are found dead in Greece.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/7/death-toll-rises-to-four-in-greece-after-floods-more-than-800-rescued>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-2-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Southeast Europe floods.

**Archived source account.** The main highway between Athens and Thessaloniki is closed due to flooding. Passenger train service between the two cities is also suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2489537-dodental-door-overstromingen-in-griekenland-turkije-en-bulgarije-loopt-op>).

Context: 2023 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Lee strengthens into a category 5 hurricane, with maximum sustained winds of 165 mph, traveling west-northwest towards the Leeward Islands and Puerto Rico.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2023/09/07/1198147021/hurricane-lee-forecast-category-5-storm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-09-07-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces that it will rejoin Horizon Europe, a European Union scientific research initiative. The UK had been excluded for the past three years due to disagreement over the Northern Ireland Protocol.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-66737714>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-09-07-4-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack / Criminal proceedings in the January 6 United States Capitol attack.

**Archived source account.** Former Trump administration economic adviser Peter Navarro is found guilty of contempt of Congress for failing to comply with a congressional subpoena issued by the January 6 committee investigating the U.S. Capitol attack.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna103790>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is arrested in Kigali, Rwanda, after fourteen people are found dead at his house. The suspected serial killer lured his victims to his house from nearby bars.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/7/rwanda-police-arrest-serial-killer-suspect-after-finding-bodies-in-kitchen>).

<a id="event-2023-09-07-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese pop agency Johnny &amp; Associates publicly admits and apologizes for sexual abuses on several hundred minors committed by its late founder Johnny Kitagawa.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/07/media/japan-kitagawa-agency-sexual-abuse-resignation-intl-hnk/index.html>).

### 2023-09-08

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Mali War / September 2023 Mali attacks.

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/spain-relying-russian-gas-overall-imports-fall-2023-09-08/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-08-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Marrakesh-Safi earthquake.

Context: 2023 Pacific typhoon season / 2023 Hong Kong rainstorm and floods.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant crisis.

Context: 80th Venice International Film Festival.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-09-09-2-1"></a>

Context: White Terror (Taiwan).

**Archived source account.** Taiwanese President Tsai Ing-wen restores the reputations of victims of the White Terror repression, which was carried out by the Kuomintang government from the 1940s to the 1980s. The ceremony, held in Taipei, marked the first nationwide event that addresses crimes committed during the White Terror.

### 2023-09-15
