#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-09-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine claims that it has recaptured the village of Andriivka, near Bakhmut, in Donetsk Oblast. Russia denied the claim and said its forces remained in control of village.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/16/russia-denies-claims-ukraine-retook-village-of-andriivka-near>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-counteroffensive-andriivka-177f5250f7a6fea3dc3924c2a50629ed>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-09-15-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United Auto Workers strike.

**Archived source account.** The United Auto Workers announce that they have gone on strike following failed negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/auto-uaw-workers-strike-gm-ford-stellantis-7ce3ca9d94b911250d07556b7af376c7>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-1-3"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia impose national import bans on 24 Ukrainian agricultural products, including grains, vegetables, meat products, and honey.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/eu-does-not-extend-ban-ukraine-grains-imports-neighbouring-eu-countries-2023-09-15/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-09-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Burkina Faso, Foreign relations of France.

**Archived source account.** The military government of Burkina Faso orders the French embassy's defense attaché to leave the country due to subversive behavior.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/09/15/Burkina-Faso-asks-French-embassy-s-defense-attach-to-leave>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-2-3"></a>

Context: France–Niger relations.

**Archived source account.** President of France Emmanuel Macron says that French ambassador to Niger Sylvain Itté and other diplomats are being held hostage at the French embassy in Niamey, Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/15/europe/french-ambassador-niger-hostage-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-2-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** President of Belarus Alexander Lukashenko proposes a three-way alliance between Belarus, Russia, and North Korea during a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Sochi, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-belarus-north-korea-putin-lukashenko-kim-82a192e032d1cda8bbbb68ddc9751c38>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-09-15-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service reports that the Wisconsin-based Green Bay Dressed Beef has recalled over 58,000 ground beef products in several states over concerns of E. coli contamination.

Source citations (as archived): [FSN](<https://www.foodsafetynews.com/2023/09/beef-packer-recalls-29-tons-of-ground-beef-because-of-e-coli-o103-contamination/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-09-15-4-2"></a>

Context: Afghan conflict / United States invasion of Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. government warns a Virginia judge that allowing a United States Marine to keep an Afghan war orphan risks violating international law and could be viewed as endorsing international child abduction.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/afghan-war-orphan-marine-baby-abduct-adoption-8a0411f16067d73ad0d86b706f5ae46d>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-4-4"></a>

Context: Human rights in Kuwait.

**Archived source account.** Kuwait University agrees to impose gender segregation in classrooms in line with a recent agreement between Kuwaiti MP Mohammed Haif al-Mutairi, who chairs the Committee for the Promotion of Values, and the Kuwaiti Minister of Education.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Arab](<https://www.newarab.com/news/kuwait-university-enforce-gender-segregation>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-4-6"></a>

Context: Cash-for-visa scandal.

**Archived source account.** The Polish Ministry of Foreign Affairs dismisses its legal chief and cancels all contracts to outsource visa applications after seven people are charged in a visas-for-cash scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-foreign-ministry-sacks-legal-chief-visa-scandal-grows-2023-09-15/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-15-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wagner Group is designated as a terrorist organization by the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wagner-group-designated-terrorist-organization-uk-officials/story?id=103226543>).

<a id="event-2023-09-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2020–2021 Thai protests.

**Archived source account.** Thai pro-democracy activist Arnon Nampa, who led protests in 2020 and 2021, is sentenced to four years in prison on a charge of royal insult.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<https://time.com/6317402/arnon-nampa-thailand-protest-lese-majeste-sentence/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Criticism of Amazon.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Trade Commission and 17 U.S. states file a lawsuit against Amazon over accusations of monopoly.

Source citations (as archived): [NP](<https://www.npr.org/2023/09/26/1191099421/amazon-ftc-lawsuit-antitrust-monopoly>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-09-26-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United Auto Workers strike.

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Joe Biden visits striking UAW workers near Detroit, Michigan, becoming the first sitting American president to join a union picket line.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2023/09/26/biden-uaw-picket-line-michigan/70969139007/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-26-3-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Burkina Faso coup d'état attempt.

**Archived source account.** Civilians protest in Ouagadougou, the capital of Burkina Faso, in support of junta leader Ibrahim Traoré amid rumors of a coup plot.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlas News](<https://theatlasnews.co/brief/2023/09/26/citizens-take-to-the-streets-amid-rumors-of-a-coup-in-burkina-faso/>).

<a id="event-2023-09-26-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Daniel Andrews announces his resignation as Premier of Victoria, Australia, after nine years in office.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2023/sep/26/daniel-dan-andrews-resigns-quits-retires-victoria-premier-update-announcement>).

<a id="event-2023-09-26-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anthony Rota resigns as speaker of the House of Commons of Canada amid controversy over his decision to invite Yaroslav Hunka, a Ukrainian–Canadian veteran of the Waffen-SS, to attend a speech by President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy and to introduce Hunka as a "hero" to the House of Commons.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/speaker-anthony-rota-resignation-1.6978422>).

Around 40 of the objects, known as Jupiter Mass Binary Objects, have been detected so far.

#### Holidays not aligned to the Gregorian Calendar

<a id="event-2023-10-07-6-1"></a>

Context: Shemini Atzeret.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Shemini Atzeret is a Jewish holiday on 22 Tishrei. Hebcal dates its 2023 observance from October 6 to October 7. The archive’s “worldwide” wording describes a religious calendar observance, rather than a measured claim of universal participation.

Editorial date: 2023-10-07. Checked: 2026-10-21. Calendar identification and dates checked. The original general wording is retained; this does not assert that every Jewish person observed the holiday.

Evidence: [Hebcal](<https://www.hebcal.com/holidays/shmini-atzeret-2023>).

Original source account: Jewish holiday celebrated worldwide

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2023-10-07-6-3"></a>

Context: Simchat Torah.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Hebcal places the separate diaspora Simchat Torah observance on October 7–8, 2023. It describes the combined Shemini Atzeret and Simchat Torah day in Israel and Reform Judaism; the source’s “rest of the world” phrasing overlooks that denominational distinction.

Editorial date: 2023-10-07. Checked: 2026-10-21. Complete wording review: retain the original assertion, with the regional generalization qualified by the calendar provider’s explicit Reform Judaism exception.

Evidence: [Hebcal](<https://www.hebcal.com/holidays/shmini-atzeret-2023>); [Hebcal](<https://www.hebcal.com/holidays/simchat-torah-2023>).

Original source account: Jewish holiday that coincides with Shemini Atzeret in Israel, and is celebrated the following day in the rest of the world.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

The casualties are transported to Gaza City’s main hospital, al-Shifa.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/diplomats-renew-calls-gaza-aid-iran-warns-israel-2023-10-16/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-war-biden-rafah-e062825a375d9eb62e95509cab95b80c>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-10-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Allied Democratic Forces gunmen shoot and kill a British and South African honeymoon couple and their local tour guide at the Queen Elizabeth National Park in Western Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-67142166>).

<a id="event-2023-10-18-0-6"></a>

Context: Gaza-Israel conflict / Israel–Hamas war / Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present) / Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia tells its citizens to immediately leave Lebanon due to the deteriorating security situation in the south of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/10/18/Saudi-Arabia-calls-on-citizens-to-immediately-leave-Lebanon>).

<a id="event-2023-10-18-0-8"></a>

Context: Gaza-Israel conflict / Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** The United States vetoes a United Nations Security Council resolution that would have condemned violence against civilians while urging humanitarian aid to Palestinians in Gaza. Twelve countries vote in favour of the resolution, while Russia and the United Kingdom abstain.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/un-rights-experts-warn-israels-actions-in-gaza-resulting-in-crimes-against-humanity/3027852>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-10-26-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** UNICEF decries the nearly 3,000 child casualties in Gaza, saying that it is a "growing stain on our collective conscience, the rate of death and injuries of children is simply staggering".

<a id="event-2023-10-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Three more UNRWA staff members are killed, thereby bringing the total to 38. Around 219 educational facilities have been damaged, including at least 29 UNRWA schools.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars>); [OCHA](<https://ochaopt.org/content/hostilities-gaza-strip-and-israel-flash-update-19>).

Fifty ambulances have also been damaged, with half of them currently unusable. Hospitals are currently operating at more than 150 percent of their capacity, with around 166 unsafe births occurring each day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/26/israel-hamas-war-live-un-ceasefire-bid-fails-as-gaza-death-toll-soars>).

### 2023-10-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1356517447](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20October%2030&oldid=1356517447>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Heavy clashes are reported as IDF tanks reach the outskirts of Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/heavy-clashes-as-israeli-tanks-reach-gaza-city-outskirts-cut-key-road>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops block the Salah al-Din Road, the main highway in the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/30/israeli-tanks-on-outskirts-of-gaza-city-with-key-road-cut>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces that its forces rescued an IDF private who was taken hostage by Hamas during an overnight operation involving its intelligence agency Shin Bet.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-captured-soldier-rescued-from-gaza-during-overnight-operation/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Re'im music festival massacre.

**Archived source account.** The family of German-Israeli tattoo artist and influencer Shani Louk confirms that she was killed during the Hamas assault on the Re'im music festival on October 7.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-770787>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/german-israeli-shani-louk-seen-paraded-by-terrorists-in-gaza-confirmed-dead/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses calls for a ceasefire in the war with Hamas, stating that Israel will continue its military operations.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/10/31/23/israel-rejects-gaza-ceasefire-as-ground-troops-free-one-hostage>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-10"></a>

Context: Yemeni civil war / Houthi–Saudi Arabian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia declares a "state of high alert" after four Saudi troops are killed in an attack by Houthi militants in Jazan Province near the border with Yemen. Saudi air defences also shoot down a ballistic missile over its territory that was travelling towards Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-10-30/saudi-arabia-clashes-with-yemen-s-houthis-rebels-putting-kingdom-on-high-alert>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and five others injured during two shootouts between supporters of rival candidates in Mindanao, Philippines, amid elections for village leaders.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/three-people-killed-as-southern-philippines-holds-village-leader-vote>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-10-30-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United Auto Workers strike.

**Archived source account.** The United Auto Workers of the United States reaches a tentative deal with General Motors, bringing an official end to the six-week strike.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/gm-reaches-tentative-deal-with-uaw-source-says-2023-10-30/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-10-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Joe Biden announces that he will remove Gabon, Niger, Uganda and the Central African Republic from the African Growth and Opportunity Act trade program, because of "gross violations" of human rights and rampant political corruption, effective January 1, 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/us-end-participation-gabon-niger-uganda-central-african-republic-trade-program-2023-10-30/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Ybor City shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and 16 others are injured in a mass shooting in the Ybor City neighborhood of Tampa, Florida, United States. A 22-year-old man is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/10/29/us/two-killed-18-injured-florida-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of the Democratic Republic of the Congo dismisses a case aiming to disqualify former Katanga governor Moïse Katumbi from the presidential election, asserting that Katumbi solely possesses Congolese nationality despite claims of dual citizenship, which the country does not recognize.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://ewn.co.za/2023/10/30/dr-congo-court-rejects-suit-questioning-opposition-leader-s-nationality>).

Context: 2023 Philippine barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan elections.

**Archived source account.** Filipinos elect members of the village and youth councils after a three-year delay.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/30/three-people-killed-as-southern-philippines-holds-village-leader-vote>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** David Adeang is elected as President of Nauru following a no-confidence vote in Russ Kun.

<a id="event-2023-10-30-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** German AfD politician Daniel Halemba is arrested for using the Nazi salute and possessing banned totalitarian symbols.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67261127.amp>); [The Guardian](<https://theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/30/far-right-german-politician-arrested-after-sieg-heil-salutes-heard>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-10-30-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a study published in Nature Geoscience, researchers suggest that solid particulates (predominantly silicate) from the Chicxulub asteroid impact played a dominant role in the radiative forcing leading to the Cretaceous–Paleogene extinction event (impact winter), contrary to the widely accepted theory that sulfur aerosols led to the mass extinction.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20231031-asteroid-dust-caused-15-year-winter-that-killed-dinosaurs-study>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/s41561-023-01290-4>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan suspends the pilot experiment of its first fully autonomous self-driving car following a minor collision.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://tribune.net.ph/2023/10/japans-first-fully-autonomous-vehicle-suspended/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-10-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023–24 EIHL season.

**Archived source account.** The South Yorkshire Police opens an investigation into the death of Adam Johnson after his neck was cut by a skate blade during a game between the Nottingham Panthers and Sheffield Steelers.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://amp.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/oct/30/police-investigate-uk-ice-hockey-tragedy-amid-tributes-to-adam-johnson>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/adam-johnson-death-police-investigating-skate-blade-cut-hockey/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-6-2"></a>

Context: 2023–24 EIHL season.

**Archived source account.** The English Ice Hockey Association announces that it will mandate neck guards and protectors beginning in 2024 following Adam Johnson’s death.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/38780913/eiha-making-neck-guards-protectors-mandatory-following-death?platform=amp>).

<a id="event-2023-10-30-6-4"></a>

Context: Rubiales affair.

**Archived source account.** FIFA bars former Royal Spanish Football Federation president Luis Rubiales from all football-related activities for three years due to Rubiales' inappropriate conduct during the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup final in August.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/fifa-luis-rubiales-spain-cd0702883950d066fe1b52e240811384>).

### 2023-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1276988180](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20October%2031&oldid=1276988180>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-3"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Eleven Israeli soldiers are killed and several others are wounded when hit by an anti-tank guided missile in northern Gaza. Seven of those killed were from the Givati Brigade.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/01/fifteen-israeli-soldiers-killed-as-fighting-intensifies-in-gaza>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-announces-another-9-soldiers-killed-fighting-in-northern-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes / 31 October 2023 Jabalia refugee camp airstrike.

**Archived source account.** More than 50 people are killed and 150 others are injured by Israeli airstrikes at the Jabalia refugee camp in the Gaza Strip. Reports indicate that the camp has been completely destroyed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/hamas-says-it-fires-israeli-troops-pressing-gaza-ground-assault-2023-10-31/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Amnesty International says that they have found that "the Israeli Army indiscriminately, and therefore unlawfully, used white phosphorous in an attack on Dhayra, in south Lebanon which "must be investigated as a war crime".

Source citations (as archived): [Amnesty International](<https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2023/10/lebanon-evidence-of-israels-unlawful-use-of-white-phosphorus-in-southern-lebanon-as-cross-border-hostilities-escalate/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-8"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Fifty-seven medical facilities have been damaged, with 32 currently inoperable due to ongoing airstrikes or lack of fuel, as Israel continue to target hospitals and medical centers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-9"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights says that an immediate humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza is "absolutely imperative".

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/immediate-humanitarian-cease-fire-absolutely-imperative-in-gaza-un-human-rights-office/3038964>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-10"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Patriarchate of Jerusalem blames Israel for the bombing of its cultural centre in Gaza City, saying that the attack "represents a stark embodiment of Israel's unwarranted determination to destroy the civil infrastructure and social service centres, as well as shelters for civilians".

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/511297.aspx>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-11"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization warns that Gaza is on the verge of a "public health catastrophe" due to overcrowding, widespread displacement, and severe damage to water and sanitation facilities, with only five percent of the normal water supplies accessible.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-12"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** UNICEF says that at least 940 children have been reported missing in Gaza. They also state that infant dehydration is a growing threat, with Gaza becoming "a graveyard of children".

Source citations (as archived): [Times Now](<https://www.timesnownews.com/world/gaza-turned-into-a-graveyard-for-children-says-unicef-article-104856896>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-13"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** UNICEF executive director Catherine Russell says that more than 420 children are being killed or injured in Gaza every day.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/31/gaza-has-become-a-graveyard-for-thousands-of-children-un>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-14"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Palestine Red Crescent Society reports continuous artillery and airstrikes near the al-Quds Hospital in northern Gaza. The hospital currently shelters hundreds of patients and more than 12,000 displaced civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-15"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Health Ministry says that 8,525 Palestinians, including 3,542 children, have been killed in Israeli air raids.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/gaza-s-death-toll-from-israeli-attacks-soars-to-8-525/3038831>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-16"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The UN agency for Palestinian refugees says that 64 of its employees have been killed during the war.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/unrwa-chief-gaza-cease-fire-matter-of-life-and-death-for-millions-/7333962.html>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-17"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Prisoners Society says that Israeli forces arrested 60 Palestinians in the West Bank, adding that the "arrests are accompanied with torture and abusive attacks, as well as collective punishment and destruction of property".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-18"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in the West Bank increases to 130 as five more Palestinians are killed by Israeli soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/1/dozens-killed-arrested-in-overnight-raids-on-west-bank-and-gaza?traffic_source=Connatix>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-20"></a>

Context: Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel intercepts three surface-to-surface missiles launched from Yemen, with at least one missile being shot down by its Arrow missile defence system. The Iran-backed Houthis claim responsibility for the launches.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.ynetnews.com/article/syz6wu0ga>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-22"></a>

Context: Mali War.

**Archived source account.** Tuareg rebels from Platform claim control over a camp in Kidal, northern Mali, following the evacuation of MINUSMA troops.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231031-mali-rebels-claim-takeover-of-vacated-un-base-near-strategic-town-of-kidal>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-0-25"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Crimea attacks.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine launches airstrikes on Crimea, destroying a Russian S-300 missile system near Yevpatoria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/post/23508>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-10-31-1-2"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war / Foreign relations of Bolivia.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia suspends diplomatic relations with Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-severs-diplomatic-ties-with-israel-citing-crimes-against-humanity-2023-10-31/>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Governments of Chile and Colombia recall their respective ambassadors to Israel as a response to Israel's military actions in the Gaza Strip.

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Foreign Affairs Minister Mélanie Joly calls for a "temporary pause in hostilities" in Gaza, saying that "the humanitarian situation facing the Palestinian people, facing Palestinian women and children, is dire".

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/news/world/israel-middle-east/joly-pleads-for-temporary-pause-in-hostilities-so-humanitarian-aid-can-reach-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-1-5"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Australian Foreign Affairs Minister Penny Wong expresses concern over growing attacks by residents of settlements on Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, saying that "such violence threatens to only inflame tensions and those responsible must be held accountable".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-10-31-1-6"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Jordanian Foreign Affairs Minister Ayman Safadi calls for an immediate stop to the "humanitarian catastrophe" in Gaza caused by Israeli bombardment and the implementation of international law, while stressing the necessity of humanitarian aid.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/31/israel-hamas-war-live-israeli-air-attacks-continue-across-gaza>).

Context: 2019 Whakaari / White Island eruption.

**Archived source account.** The District Court of New Zealand in Auckland finds Whakaari's management guilty of insufficiently protecting visitors during the volcanic eruption that resulted in 22 deaths and 25 severe injuries.

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of demonstrators gather in front of the Israeli embassy in Manila, Philippines, to denounce the Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip.

## November

### 2023-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1197675390](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20November%201&oldid=1197675390>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** Two shepherds are killed in the village of Wazzani, Lebanon, after Israeli soldiers opened fire in their direction, while a 16-year-old boy is killed during shelling by the Israeli Army, bringing the death toll in Lebanon to 66.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/articles/israeli-fire-kills-two-lebanese-shepherds-state-media-ae2dd6e0>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** About 500 people, including injured Palestinians, foreigners and dual Palestinian–foreign nationals, are evacuated from the Gaza Strip through the Rafah Border Crossing to Egypt, marking the border crossing's first opening since the war began.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/qatar-brokers-deal-between-egypt-hamas-and-israel-for-limited-gaza-evacuations-source>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israel deploys Sa'ar-class corvettes to the Red Sea in response to missile and drone attacks from Yemen. Israeli National Security Council official Tzachi Hanegbi says that the Houthi attacks on Israel are "intolerable".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-deploys-missile-boats-red-sea-regional-tensions-surge-2023-11-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Iran–Israel proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Foreign Affairs Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian warns of "harsh consequences" if Israel continues its invasion of the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-warns-harsh-consequences-if-gaza-attacks-continue-2023-11-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-9"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes.

**Archived source account.** The Jabalia refugee camp in the Gaza Strip is hit by Israeli airstrike for the second consecutive day, with several more people being killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/11/1/photos-dozens-killed-in-another-strike-on-jabalia-refugee-camp-in-gaza>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-10"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli soldier is killed in a mortar attack near the kibbutz of Be'eri in southern Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-confirms-sgt-first-class-shalev-sharabi-killed-by-mortar-fire-near-gaza/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-01-0-12"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Siege of Gaza City.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops and tanks continue to encircle Gaza City, with heavy clashes reported on the city's outskirts. Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad say that they are using "hit-and-run attacks" from tunnels to attempt to stop the advance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gaza-says-israels-strikes-refugee-camp-kill-more-than-195-people-2023-11-02/>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/lebanons-hezbollah-says-it-attacked-israeli-position-using-drones-2023-11-02/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

Sixteen of the Gaza Strip's 35 hospitals and more than 50 of its 72 primary healthcare clinics are now unusable.

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes / 31 October 2023 Jabalia refugee camp airstrike.

Context: Arab–Israeli conflict / Israel–Hamas war / Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes / 31 October 2023 Jabalia refugee camp airstrike.

More than a quarter of the nearly 30,000 foreign workers have left the country and about 20,000 Palestinian agricultural workers have not been allowed to enter Israel.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-11-02-2-2"></a>

Context: 2023–24 European windstorm season / Storm Ciarán.

**Archived source account.** Storm Ciarán impacts northwestern Europe, killing six people, including two in Belgium, two in France, and one each in Spain and the Netherlands, and causing mass disruption to transport. Widespread damage from 100 mph winds are reported in the Channel Islands, while 1.2 million French households are left without electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/environment-agency-channel-islands-jersey-caroline-abrahams-age-uk-b2440244.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/storm-ciaran-lashes-northern-europe-with-strong-winds-rain-one-killed-france-2023-11-02/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-02-2-3"></a>

Context: 2023–24 European windstorm season / Storm Ciarán.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed during heavy rains in the region of Tuscany, Italy, with rivers flooding and causing damage. Several roads and highways are closed amid landslides, and dozens of buildings are damaged. Severe damage also occurred in Campobasso, Molise, evacuations are being made in Veneto with highways being closed, and emergency calls occurred in Rome. In Sardinia, strong winds fueled fires that burned hectares of vegetation, while a man is killed in Capoterra, and in Tortolì an entire sawmill burned down.

Source citations (as archived): [Rai News](<https://www.rainews.it/maratona/2023/11/la-tempesta-ciaran-francia-e-canale-della-manica-in-allarme-allerta-rossa-in-veneto-e-friuli-maltempo-a5b01f9f-5086-4587-a209-5f0d53dbfc39.html>).

Context: Italy–Ukraine relations.

**Archived source account.** Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni states that European leaders are tired of the war in Ukraine and want to broker a deal with the Kremlin, saying that "we need a way out" during a phone call in which she thought she was talking with a senior African Union official, but was actually speaking to Russian comedians Vovan and Lexus.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/11/01/giorgia-meloni-european-leaders-tired-ukraine-war-prank/>).

Context: Russia and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs a law formally withdrawing Russia's ratification of the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty. However, Russia maintains that it will not resume nuclear weapons testing unless the United States also resumes testing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-revokes-russias-ratification-nuclear-test-ban-treaty-2023-11-02/>).

**Archived source account.** The American Civil Liberties Union urges higher education institutions to respect free speech and to resist calls to investigate or disband student organisations rallying on behalf of Palestinian rights, warning against politically motivated efforts to police speech on campus, which they say could "destroy the foundation on which academic communities are built".

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/business/11/03/23/former-crypto-tycoon-sam-bankman-fried-found-guilty-on-all-counts-at-fraud-trial>).

### 2023-11-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360228053](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20November%205&oldid=1360228053>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Siege of Gaza City.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces announce the complete encirclement of Gaza City and say that they have split the Gaza Strip in two after Israeli troops reach the coast.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-troops-have-encircled-gaza-city-split-coastal-enclave-into-two/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-05-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Jordanian Air Force airdrops medical aid to a field hospital inside the Gaza Strip.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/jordanian-air-force-airdrops-urgent-aid-for-gaza-strip/3044922>).

<a id="event-2023-11-05-0-7"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

**Editorial account; source review partial.** AFP, citing Lebanon’s National News Agency, reported a grandmother and three grandchildren killed in a car following a journalist’s vehicle. A separate AFP report attributed injuries to four rescuers in a two-ambulance strike at Tayr Harfa to the ambulance association and state media; it also recorded Israel’s differing account of its target.

Editorial date: 2023-11-05. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: the source appears to conflate the fatal civilian-car incident with ambulance vehicles. Preserve both reports’ attribution and the original source error; the remaining injury details are not fully established here.

Evidence: [AFP via Digital Journal](<https://www.digitaljournal.com/world/lebanon-says-israeli-strike-kills-reporters-4-relatives/article>); [AFP via Times of Malta](<https://timesofmalta.com/article/four-wounded-israel-strike-lebanon-ambulances.1065663>).

Original source account: Three children and a woman are killed, and several others are injured, when two ambulances carrying civilians are hit by an Israeli airstrike near the towns of Ainata and Aitaroun, Lebanon, and four paramedics are injured when two ambulances are bombed in Tayr Harfa.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2023-11-05-0-8"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** In response to Israeli airstrikes, Hezbollah launches an anti-tank guided missile towards Kiryat Shmona, killing a civilian and shoots down an Israeli Elbit Hermes 450 drone over Nabatieh.

Source citations (as archived): [News9Live](<https://www.news9live.com/videos/world-videos/hezbollah-shoots-down-israeli-drone-in-nabatieh-region-2341533>).

<a id="event-2023-11-05-0-9"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231105-lebanon-says-israeli-strike-kills-reporter-s-4-relatives>); [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-civilian-killed-in-anti-tank-missile-attack-from-lebanon-amid-escalation/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-06-3-1"></a>

The trial marks the first time in modern France that a government minister has been put on trial while still in office.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-11-07-1-1"></a>

Context: 2021–2023 inflation surge.

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh increases the minimum wage for garment workers by nearly 56% to BDT 12,500 (US$113) per month, a move trade unions find insufficient against their demand for a BDT 23,000 ($208) threshold amid rising costs of living and inflation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/bangladesh-increases-garment-workers-minimum-pay-by-56-report-4553921>).

<a id="event-2023-11-07-1-3"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The International Labour Organization reports that job losses in Gaza and the West Bank are costing Palestinians US$16 million per day, with 182,000 jobs lost in Gaza, equivalent to 61 percent of the territory's total employment. A further 208,000 jobs were lost in the West Bank, equivalent to 24 percent of the territory's total employment.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/7/more-than-60-percent-of-jobs-lost-in-gaza-due-to-war-un-agency-says>).

Context: 2023 heat waves.

**Archived source account.** The Copernicus Climate Change Service reports that October 2023 is the hottest October observed, having surpassed previous temperature records with global temperatures averaging 1.43 °C change above preindustrial levels.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20231108-record-temperatures-in-october-guarantee-2023-will-be-warmest-year-in-history>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-08-0-1"></a>

Context: 2023 attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq and Syria.

**Archived source account.** A United States Air Force MQ-9 Reaper is shot down in international airspace off the coast of Yemen. The Iran-backed Houthis claim responsibility for the shooting.

**Archived source account.** An independent United Nations expert says that widespread and systematic bombardment of housing and civilian infrastructure in Gaza amounts to a war crime and a crime against humanity.

### 2023-11-09

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2023 attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq and Syria.

The Yemen-based Houthis claim responsibility, but the Israel Defense Forces blame an unspecified organization in Syria for the strike.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-says-unidentified-drone-hits-southern-city-eilat-2023-11-09/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu says that the Israel Defense Forces will control the Gaza Strip after the war ends, rejecting calls for an international peacekeeping force to be stationed there.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/netanyahu-says-idf-will-control-gaza-after-war-rejects-notion-of-international-force/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** A video is released showing a Palestinian prisoner being used as a human shield during the Israeli operation in the West Bank. The prisoner is handcuffed, blindfolded and kneeling on a street, as an Israeli soldier takes cover behind him, while aiming his rifle.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/10/israel-hamas-war-live-fears-grow-for-palestinians-at-gaza-hospitals>).

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The UN human rights commissioner urges an investigation into Israel's use of "high-impact explosive weapons" in Gaza, which caused indiscriminate destruction in the enclave and also stated that Israel must "end its use of such weapons".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-must-protect-palestinians-west-bank-un-rights-chief-2023-11-10/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The UN human rights commissioner says that Israel must take immediate measures to protect Palestinians in the West Bank, saying that Palestinians were "subjected to violence from Israeli forces and settlers, ill treatment, arrests, evictions, intimidation and humiliation" on a daily basis.

Source citations (as archived): [US News](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2023-11-10/israel-must-protect-palestinians-in-the-west-bank-un-rights-chief>).

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed in an Israeli airstrike on the Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City. Human Rights Watch comments "hospitals must always be protected" and "no area is a free-fire zone", urging world leaders to act "to prevent further mass atrocities".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/10/israel-hamas-war-live-fears-grow-for-palestinians-at-gaza-hospitals>).

<a id="event-2023-11-10-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations warns that if the war in Gaza continues for a second month, poverty among Palestinians will increase by 34 percent, causing nearly half a million people to experience poverty. After a third month, GDP will decline by more than 12 percent, with losses of US$2.5 billion for the economy, and causing more than 660,000 people to experience poverty.

### 2023-11-11

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-11-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Siege of Gaza City.

**Archived source account.** The director of the Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City says that the medical complex is "completely cut off", with any "moving person targeted" by Israeli forces. Médecins Sans Frontières confirms reports that people are being shot at as they try to exit the hospital. Palestinian health minister Mai al-Kaila says that Israeli forces have also shelled the hospital with white phosphorus munitions which are banned under international law.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/11/israeli-forces-close-in-on-al-shifa-hospital-trapping-thousands>); [Al Jazeera 2](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/11/we-are-minutes-away-from-death-gazas-al-shifa-hospital-under-attack>); [Al Jazeera 3](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals>).

<a id="event-2023-11-11-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Siege of Gaza City.

**Archived source account.** Israeli tanks and snipers fire at the Al-Quds Hospital in Gaza City from within twenty meters, where around 14,000 displaced people are sheltering in a state of "extreme panic and fear", according to the Palestinian Red Crescent.

**Archived source account.** The UN Humanitarian Affairs Office reports that at least 45 Palestinians have been displaced in the West Bank following Israeli punitive demolitions.

<a id="event-2023-11-11-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Digital rights organization Access Now says that shutdowns affecting internet access in the Gaza Strip are providing "cover for human rights atrocities", which are being worsened by Israel's control over internet access.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals>).

<a id="event-2023-11-11-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Norwegian Refugee Council condemns Israeli attacks on Gaza hospitals, calling for an urgent ceasefire and for the protection of medical staff, saying that "it is an affront to wage war around and on hospitals".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/11/israel-hamas-war-live-pleas-for-help-as-israel-bombards-gaza-hospitals>).

<a id="event-2023-11-11-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs says that the transfer of solid waste to landfills has stopped across the Gaza Strip because of insecurity and a shortage of fuel. The World Health Organization reports that the spread of infectious diseases including diarrhea and chickenpox are increasing rapidly, with medical organizations warning of the risk of a possible cholera epidemic.

Another eight people, including one child, were killed by Israeli settlers in East Jerusalem.

Strickland is temporarily replaced by Bishop Joe S. Vásquez of the Diocese of Austin. The decision comes after Strickland declined to resign when asked to do so.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1788681/un-office-in-gaza-shelled-reports-of-casualties-and-injuries-undp-chief>).

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations says that several hospitals in Gaza have been directly hit, and that "hospitals are explicitly entitled to specific protection under international humanitarian law", as Israel intensifies its shelling and ground attacks around hospitals in Gaza City and northern Gaza.

<a id="event-2023-11-12-0-9"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Gaza war.

**Archived source account.** The cardiac ward of the Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, is destroyed by Israel's ground offensive and the hospital's intensive care unit is severely damaged by Israeli army bombing. The World Health Organization (WHO) says that there are reports that people who fled the hospital "have been shot at, wounded and even killed" and calls for a humanitarian ceasefire, saying that they are concerned about the safety of workers and patients who remain inside the hospital. The WHO also says that it has lost communication with its contacts inside the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [The Journal](<https://www.thejournal.ie/netanyahu-israel-gaza-hospital-6220799-Nov2023/>); [WHO](<https://www.emro.who.int/media/news/who-loses-communication-with-contacts-in-al-shifa-hospital-in-gaza-amid-reports-of-attacks.html>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital>); [Al Jazeera 2](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/12/israel-gaza-war-live-israeli-army-surrounding-al-quds-hospital>).

**Archived source account.** A Norse Atlantic Airways Boeing 787 lands at Troll Airfield in Antarctica, making it the first time that this type of aircraft has landed in Antarctica.

Source citations (as archived): [Flightradar24](<https://www.flightradar24.com/blog/787-in-antarctica/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-16-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Casgevy, a world-first gene therapy that aims to cure sickle-cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia, is approved by the UK's Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency, becoming the first drug using CRISPR to be licensed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-67435266>).

Context: 2023–24 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** Everton Football Club receives a 10-point deduction this season for breaching the Premier League's profit and sustainability rules, having made losses of £124.5 million (around US$155 million) in the three years up to 2021–22, with the limit being £105 million ($131 million). **Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Office says that more than 10,000 civilians have been killed in Ukraine since the Russian invasion in February 2022, though it expects the actual death toll to be "significantly higher".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/civilian-death-toll-ukraine-tops-10000-un-human-rights-office-2023-11-21/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** Al-Qassam Brigade militants; three pro-Hezbollah Al Mayadeen television station journalists and a civilian are killed and a civilian is injured by Israeli shelling and airstrikes in Chaaitiyeh, Khiam, Kafr Kila and Tayr Harfa, southern Lebanon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/lebanon-2-journalists-another-civilian-killed-in-idf-strike-amid-hezbollah-clashes/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

Source citations (as archived): [AlArabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/11/21/Israel-strikes-south-Lebanon-elderly-woman-killed->); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/two-reporters-killed-near-lebanese-border-with-israel-lebanon-state-news-agency-2023-11-21/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Congolese Foreign Minister Christophe Lutundula announces that the DRC has signed agreements for the complete withdrawal of the MONUSCO United Nations peacekeeping force. The UN has around 15,000 peacekeepers stationed in the Central African country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/united-nations-congo-peacekeepers-monusco-35764b2e37becb8febfbdb313e7b851b>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-11"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war / Operation 1027.

**Archived source account.** The Arakan Army assaults Pauktaw, Rakhine State, for a second time. The town has switched hands twice between the rebel group and the military.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/arakan-army-in-fierce-fighting-to-retake-town-near-rakhine-capital-from-myanmar-junta.html>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-14"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces seize the Sudanese Armed Forces 20th Infantry Division headquarters in Ed Daein, East Darfur, effectively capturing the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article279589/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-21-0-15"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Darfur campaign.

**Archived source account.** At least 40 civilians are killed and more than 50 others are injured when Sudanese army warplanes bomb the vicinity of the 20th Infantry Division in East Darfur.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article279625/>).

### 2023-11-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1197710649](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20November%2022&oldid=1197710649>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Israel approves a deal to pause fighting in Gaza for four days. The deal, negotiated by Egypt, Qatar, and the United States, will also see Israel release 150 Palestinian prisoners in exchange for the release of some of the hostages held by Hamas, mostly women and children.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/cabinet-approves-deal-for-return-of-50-hostages-in-exchange-for-multi-day-ceasefire/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-11-22-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sam Altman returns as CEO of American artificial intelligence company OpenAI, only days after being dismissed by the company's Board of Directors on November 17. The surprise dismissal had resulted in major pushback, with 95% of company workers saying that they would quit if Altman was not brought back as CEO.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-67494165>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-11-22-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Rainbow Bridge explosion.

**Archived source account.** A car explodes near the Canada–United States border at the Rainbow Bridge in Niagara Falls, New York, United States, killing the two people inside the vehicle and injuring a border agent. The New York state government temporarily closes all border crossings between the United States and Canada in Western New York in response to the explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/authorities-monitoring-incident-bridge-niagara-falls-ny-governor-says-2023-11-22/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-11-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Chinese pneumonia outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization requests detailed information from China regarding a surge in respiratory diseases and pneumonia clusters among children in northern China, while advising the public to adhere to preventative measures against such diseases.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/china/who-advises-chinese-to-take-measures-amid-respiratory-illness-spike/articleshow/105429350.cms>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-11-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Finland–Russia relations.

**Archived source account.** Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo announces that Finland will close all but the northernmost border crossing with Russia, amid an increase in asylum seekers entering Finland via Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-close-all-one-border-crossing-with-russia-pm-2023-11-22/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-11-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Dutch general election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of the Netherlands elect all 150 seats in the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2023/11/22/europe/netherlands-election-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-11-22-5-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Dutch general election.

**Archived source account.** The far-right Party for Freedom led by Geert Wilders wins the most seats in parliament, according to exit polls.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/22/far-right-party-set-to-win-most-seats-in-dutch-elections-exit-polls-show>).

### 2023-11-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1200531676](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20November%2023&oldid=1200531676>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Al-Shifa Hospital siege.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces detain Mohammad abu Salmiya, the director of the Al-Shifa Hospital, and several doctors working under him, after a convoy belonging to the World Health Organization was stopped by Israeli soldiers. Israel accuses the director and the doctors of having sheltered Hamas fighters in the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/nov/23/israels-army-arrests-gaza-hospital-director-and-bombs-300-targets-amid-truce-delay>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** CENTCOM reports that the USS Thomas Hudner has shot down "multiple" Israel-bound attack drones launched from Houthi-controlled Yemen over the Red Sea. No injuries or damage are reported.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/policy/international/4324690-us-warship-attack-drones-red-sea/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** A Russian cluster munition strike in Chornobaivka, Kherson, kills at least three civilians. Five people are also injured by Russian artillery shelling with more than 60 residential buildings reportedly damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ukraine-3-civilians-killed-russian-shelling-russia-drone-105121065>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-11-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Modern immigration to the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Office for National Statistics reports that net migration to the United Kingdom reached a record of 745,000 in 2022, with the vast majority of arrivals being from non-EU countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/net-migration-rose-to-672-000-in-year-to-june-up-from-607-000-in-the-previous-year-latest-ons-figures-show-13013846>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-11-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Chinese pneumonia outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that Chinese authorities have not detected any unusual or new pathogens in the recent increase of respiratory diseases among children in northern China. The WHO continues to monitor the situation.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/china-reports-no-unusual-pathogens-in-respiratory-illness-surge-who-4601367>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-2-3"></a>

Context: Mpox in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports the first sexual transmission case of mpox in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in a Belgium resident who traveled there.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/24/who-confirms-monkeypox-spreads-sexually-in-dr-congo-amid-outbreak>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-11-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Seoul, South Korea, orders Japan to pay compensation of ₩200 million (around JPY 22 million or US$154,000) to 16 comfort women, overturning a previous ruling that denied the women's claims due to sovereign immunity.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://mb.com.ph/2023/11/23/s-korea-court-rules-in-favour-of-victims-of-wartime-sexual-slavery>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-3-3"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea terminates its 2018 agreement with South Korea, citing escalations in military provocations as well as plans to deploy military forces along the Military Demarcation Line.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/11/23/north-korea-suspends-military-accord-with-south-after-satellite-launch_6280043_4.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-11-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Dublin riot.

**Archived source account.** Rioting occurs in Dublin, Ireland, following a mass stabbing outside a school which injured a woman and three children. Garda Commissioner Drew Harris blames "far-right hooligans" for the unrest.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/dublin-ireland-stabbing-children-9a75c71fbac34fe789220c684c5eb661>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chad's junta parliament approves an amnesty law, terminating prosecutions and convictions related to the 2022 anti-government protest deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/chad-grants-general-amnesty-ending-prosecution-verdicts-over-deaths-of-protesters-in-2022-anti-govt-rally-101700765876416.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-11-23-5-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests.

**Archived source account.** Pro-Palestine protesters disrupt the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City, United States, minutes after the start of the parade. The parade resumes after the protesters are taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/pro-palestinian-protesters-force-macys-thanksgiving-day-temporarily/story?id=105124720>).

<a id="event-2023-11-23-5-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests.

**Archived source account.** Cubans hold a pro-Palestine protest at the Embassy of the United States in Havana, Cuba.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/cuba-stages-pro-palestine-march-past-us-embassy-havana-2023-11-23/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

<a id="event-2023-11-25-0-4"></a>
