**Archived source account.** The International Olympic Committee announces that a French Alps/Nice bid is the preferred candidate to host the 2030 Winter Olympics and that Salt Lake City, Utah, United States, is the preferred candidate to host the 2034 Winter Olympics.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<https://www.cbc.ca/sports/olympics/olympics-winter-hosts-france-salt-lake-city-1.7043563>).

### 2023-11-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1197711466](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20November%2030&oldid=1197711466>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Givat Shaul shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three Israeli civilians are killed and sixteen injured in a mass shooting in the Givat Shaul neighborhood of Jerusalem. Two Palestinian gunmen are shot and killed by security forces. An armed civilian who shot the Palestinian attackers, Yuval Doron Castleman, is mistaken for an attacker and is also shot dead. Hamas claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-november-30-2023/>); [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-11-30/ty-article/three-israelis-killed-in-jerusalem-attack-hamas-affiliated-assailants-shot-dead/0000018c-1f4a-da36-a1de-5f6fc5200000>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** A deal is reached to extend the ceasefire for at least one more day after it had been due to expire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/truce-in-gaza-counts-down-to-end-at-7-a-m-thursday-amid-efforts-to-extend/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has expressed doubts that Israel is abiding by international law in the war, due to the high number of civilian casualties and video footage of growing numbers of children dying.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/30/serious-doubt-israel-complying-with-international-law-spains-sanchez>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Antony Blinken steps up calls for Israel to comply with international law and protect civilians during its military operations in southern Gaza, while reaffirming US support.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/30/blinken-pledges-support-for-israel-as-gaza-truce-extend-for-third-time>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine says its special forces bombed a freight train as it was passing through the Severomuysky Tunnel in Buryatia, Russia. Russia's Investigative Committee acknowledges an explosion and fire inside the tunnel, and says that a preliminary probe is underway to determine the cause.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraines-sbu-targets-rail-line-deep-inside-russian-siberia-source-2023-11-30/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gunfire breaks out between the National Guard of Guinea-Bissau and the Presidential Guard after the National Guard frees two ministers from the opposition PAIGC from police custody.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67586556>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/1/heavy-gunfire-heard-overnight-in-guinea-bissau-capital>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-11-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Russian grain exports.

**Archived source account.** Somalia receives 25,000 tons of grain as humanitarian aid from Russia. It is part of an agreement announced at the 2023 Russia–Africa Summit to provide food to African nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/africa/somalia-receives-25-000-tons-of-grain-from-russia-as-humanitarian-aid/3069465>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The insolvency of the Austrian Signa Holding leads to the insolvency of the German sporting goods retailer SportScheck.

Source citations (as archived): [rbb24](<https://www.rbb24.de/wirtschaft/beitrag/2023/11/berlin-brandenburg-sportscheck-insolvent-signa-holding.html>).

#### Disasters and incidents

<a id="event-2023-11-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed in a fire at a hostel in Almaty, Kazakhstan, with preliminary reports indicating carbon monoxide poisoning as the cause of death.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231130-fire-at-dawn-in-kazakhstan-hostel-kills-13>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-11-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Climate Change conference opens in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with an agreement to provide funding to least developed countries that are most at risk from the effects of climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2023/nov/30/agreement-on-loss-and-damage-deal-expected-on-first-day-of-cop28-talks>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-11-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Incoming Foreign Minister Diana Mondino announces that Argentina will not join the BRICS group of nations, as it already has members of the BRICS bloc as the country's primary trading partners.

Source citations (as archived): [MyInd Markets](<https://www.myind.net/Home/viewArticle/argentina-has-declined-the-invitation-to-join-the-brics>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-11-30-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Russia bans the LGBT movement, labelling participants as extremists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/top-russian-court-bans-lgbt-movement-extremist-2023-11-30/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-11-30-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023–24 Bhutanese National Assembly election.

**Archived source account.** Citizens of Bhutan vote in the preliminary round of elections to elect members of the National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bhutan-votes-preliminary-round-national-elections-2023-11-30/>).

<a id="event-2023-11-30-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele is granted a leave of absence prior to the 2024 general election and is succeeded by his private secretary Claudia Rodríguez de Guevara as acting president.

Source citations (as archived): [La Prensa Gráfica](<https://www.laprensagrafica.com/elsalvador/Asamblea-otorga-permiso-a-Bukele-para-que-realice-campana-20231130-0091.html>).


## December

### 2023-12-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360221881](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%201&oldid=1360221881>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** The ceasefire between Israel and Hamas ends when a deadline expires on the seventh day. Mediator Qatar says that efforts are ongoing to renew the ceasefire and expressed regret over the resumption of Israeli bombardments.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-12-1-2023-0c225e35008879ea7574aabb077596f2>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** More than 180 Palestinians are killed and hundreds more are injured by Israeli airstrikes on different parts of the Gaza Strip, including the community of Abasan al-Kabira and a home northwest of Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/1/more-than-170-killed-as-israel-resumes-bombing-of-gaza-after-truce-expires>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-war-live-updates-12-1-2023-0c225e35008879ea7574aabb077596f2>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israel–Hamas ceasefire.

**Archived source account.** Aid is stranded near Egypt’s border with Gaza, with truck drivers saying they expected further delays to a complex delivery process that had briefly speeded up during the weeklong truce.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/1/gaza-aid-trucks-stranded-as-israel-hamas-war-resumes>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-6"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** Israeli shelling kills a woman and her son in Hula, Lebanon in southern Lebanon with a Hezbollah militant killed in an ensuing firefight with IDF.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/1/at-least-three-killed-in-south-lebanon-as-israel-hezbollah-resume-fighting>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Malawians travel to Israel to work as farm labourers. Kondwani Nankhumwa, leader of the Democratic Progressive Party, has questioned the secrecy of the deal amidst the governments awareness of the ongoing war.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2023/12/1/apprehension-as-malawi-sends-workers-to-israel>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-10"></a>

Context: Iraqi conflict / Kurdish–Turkish conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Air Force launches airstrikes on Kurdistan Workers' Party positions in northern Iraq, reportedly destroying 16 of their targets and killing a number of separatist militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-air-strikes-hit-16-kurdish-militant-targets-northern-iraq-ministry-2023-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-11"></a>

Context: Iraqi conflict.

**Archived source account.** At least eleven civilians are killed in an attack by an armed group in Miqdadiyah, Diyala Governorate, Iraq. No group has claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/iraq-diyala-islamic-state-attack-1c85291fa970f200946267c3e47a4ab1>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-13"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Eleven Dawla Islamiyah and Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters militants are killed during a raid by the Philippine Army in Datu Hoffer Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/philippines-muslim-rebels-dawla-islamiyah-bangsamoro-b3938d2efaf9e3238156b93b63035af4>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-15"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war.

**Archived source account.** Allied Karenni rebel groups and local PDF forces launch attacks on junta bases in Kawkareik, Karen State.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/karen-resistance-attacks-myanmar-junta-in-kawkareik.html>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-17"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) lifts an arms embargo on the Somali Armed Forces and the Somali government, while continuing sanctions against the al-Shabaab jihadist group.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thedefensepost.com/2023/12/02/un-lifts-arms-embargo-somalia/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-0-19"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** The UNSC adopts a resolution to end the mandate of its United Nations Integrated Transition Assistance Mission in Sudan (UNITAMS) by December 3.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Dabanga](<https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/unsc-expected-to-terminate-unitams-mission-in-sudan>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-12-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** For his role in the film Passages, Franz Rogowski is honored by the New York Film Critics Circle as best leading actor of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Der Spiegel](<https://www.spiegel.de/kultur/kino/franz-rogowski-schauspielerpreis-des-new-york-film-critics-circle-gewonnen-a-1d8b78b1-e550-4180-840d-94f3cb3d39d1>); [Variety](<https://variety.com/2023/film/awards/new-york-film-critics-circle-winners-list-2023-1235814072/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-12-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Sri Lankan economic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lanka's efforts to restructure its debt run into difficulty when an ad hoc group of private creditors object that the official creditors and Sri Lanka itself are being insufficiently transparent about their talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/sri-lanka-bondholders-raise-concerns-over-debt-deal-transparency-2023-12-01/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-12-01-3-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Guyana–Venezuela crisis / 2023 Venezuelan referendum.

**Archived source account.** The International Court of Justice (ICJ) orders Venezuela to refrain from any action that would alter the status quo in Guayana Esequiba ahead of a referendum on its rights to the disputed territory, but does not forbid Venezuela from going ahead with the referendum as Guyana requested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/world-court-orders-venezuela-refrain-action-border-dispute-with-guyana-2023-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-3-4"></a>

Context: Child abductions in the Russo-Ukrainian War.

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross suspends the Belarus Red Cross after its Secretary General Dzmitry Shautsou refuses to resign following statements that the organization was involved in bringing Ukrainian children to Belarus for health improvement purposes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/belarus-red-cross-russia-ukraine-war-children-fecce3dd920565e5299737de4a9a86f3>); [Nasha Niva](<https://nashaniva.com/331371>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-3-6"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Coast Guard establishes a surveillance station on the disputed Thitu Island in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/south-china-sea-disputes-philippines-thitu-island-b19fe639fb1d2127a2d7a77adc59d6a9>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Los Angeles.

**Archived source account.** A serial killer is suspected of having fatally shot three homeless men during the past week in Los Angeles, California, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/3-men-experiencing-homelessness-fatally-shot-potential-serial/story?id=105319218>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 118th United States Congress.

**Archived source account.** George Santos is expelled from the United States House of Representatives over criminal corruption charges and accusations of misspending campaign money.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-lawmaker-george-santos-indicted-fraud-charges-faces-house-expulsion-vote-2023-12-01/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-01-5-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Malagasy presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Madagascar's supreme court confirms Andry Rajoelina's election as president after dismissing several challenges against the provisional results.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/madagascar-leader-wins-presidential-vote-constitutional-court-says-2023-12-01/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-12-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea launches its first military reconnaissance satellite from the Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, United States, carried by a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3243598/south-korea-launches-first-spy-satellite-spacex-tightening-space-race-north>).

### 2023-12-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1201785514](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%202&oldid=1201785514>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** More than 190 Palestinians are killed and hundreds more are wounded by Israeli airstrikes on the Gaza Strip, including Khan Younis in the south.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/israeli-bombs-hundreds-of-targets-in-gaza-as-truce-efforts-continue>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations say the fighting will worsen the extreme humanitarian emergency in Gaza. UN aid chief Martin Griffiths said that the people of Gaza had nowhere safe to go and very little to survive on.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/israeli-bombs-hundreds-of-targets-in-gaza-as-truce-efforts-continue>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United States provides BLU-109 bunker buster bombs and other munitions to Israel. Similar bombs made by the US were used by Israel in the Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes, including a strike that levelled an apartment block, killing more than 100 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/us-gives-bunker-buster-bombs-to-israel-for-war-on-gaza-report>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-7"></a>

Context: Islamic terrorism in Europe, Terrorism in France / 2023 Paris attack.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and two others are injured in a knife and hammer attack near the Eiffel Tower in Paris, France. The suspect is arrested by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-dead-one-injured-after-assailant-attacks-passersby-paris-minister-2023-12-02/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Bomb maker Mundi Sawadjaan, a leader of Abu Sayyaf and suspect in the 2020 suicide bombings in Sulu, is killed by security forces during a military operation in Basilan, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2023/12/03/abu-sayyaf-bomb-maker-killed-by-philippine-security-forces>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-0-12"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Chilas bus shooting.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and 26 others injured in a mass shooting against a bus on the Karakoram Highway near the town of Chilas, Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/gunmen-kill-eight-bus-passengers-in-northern-pakistan>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-12-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The cooling tower of the decommissioned Voerde power station in NRW, Germany is blown up.

Source citations (as archived): [NRZ](<https://www.nrz.de/staedte/dinslaken-huenxe-voerde/kuehlturm-sprengung-die-wichtigsten-fragen-und-antworten-id240689308.html>); [RWE](<https://www.rwe.com/presse/rwe-generation/2023-11-10-rwe-kuendigt-sprengtermin-fuer-kuehlturm-des-steinkohlekraftwerks-in-voerde-an/>); [WDR](<https://www1.wdr.de/nachrichten/rheinland/sprengung-kuehlturm-voerde-100.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-12-02-2-1"></a>

Context: December 2023 Mindanao earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A person is killed when a 7.5 magnitude earthquake strikes off the coast of Mindanao, Philippines. Tsunami warnings are issued for the Philippines and Japan, but are later lifted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-lifts-tsunami-alert-after-magnitude-74-earthquake-2023-12-03/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Al-Qadir Trust case.

**Archived source account.** The Pakistan Movement for Justice party appoints Gohar Ali Khan as its new chairman, replacing party founder and former Prime Minister Imran Khan, who remains detained on various charges.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thedailystar.net/news/asia/south-asia/news/pakistan-ex-pm-imran-khan-replaced-party-head-3483991>).

<a id="event-2023-12-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Human rights in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's security service stops former president Petro Poroshenko from leaving the country. Poroshenko's political party, European Solidarity, said he had scheduled meetings in Poland and the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20231202-ukraine-blocks-ex-president-from-leaving-country-amid-alleged-plan-to-meet-pro-putin-hungary-s-orban>).

### 2023-12-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1239549142](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%203&oldid=1239549142>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip.

**Archived source account.** At least 700 Palestinians have been killed during the last 24 hours by Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip. Rights groups object to Israel's increased attacks in southern Gaza, which Israel had declared as a "safe zone".

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/3/over-700-killed-as-israel-pounds-gaza-widens-evacuation-orders>).

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The USS Carney and multiple civilian-owned commercial ships are attacked by the Houthis in the Red Sea. At least three cargo ships are hit by missiles, according to the United States Central Command.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2023/12/03/yemen-explosion-shipping-british/6b0a0b08-91be-11ee-9d5c-d462c9032daa_story.html>); [The Drive](<https://www.thedrive.com/the-war-zone/three-cargo-sips-hit-by-houthi-missiles-u-s-destroyer-downs-drones>).

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-7"></a>

Context: Iraqi conflict / Attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria (2023–present).

**Archived source account.** A CJTF-OIR drone strike kills five militants near Kirkuk, Iraq, in response to rocket and drone attacks on U.S. and coalition forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/12/04/US-responds-to-drone-attack-in-Iraq-kills-five-militants-CENTCOM>).

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-9"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** 11 Israelis injured by a Hezbollah missile targeting an IDF base in Beit Hillel and Global Affairs Canada announced that a Canadian citizen was killed in Lebanon of unspecified causes.

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-11"></a>

Context: Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** The East African Community's task force begins withdrawing from North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after the country refused to renew the force's mandate.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231203-east-african-regional-force-begins-withdrawal-from-drc>).

<a id="event-2023-12-03-0-14"></a>

Context: Moro conflict, Terrorism in the Philippines / Mindanao State University bombing.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and around 50 others are injured in a bombing during a Catholic Mass at Mindanao State University in Marawi, Bangsamoro, Philippines. The Islamic State claims responsibility for the bombing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/three-dead-southern-philippines-university-gym-blast-media-2023-12-03/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-12-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alaska Airlines announces their intent to acquire Hawaiian Airlines in a deal worth $1.9 billion. The new company will maintain separate operations for both brands.

Source citations (as archived): [Honolulu Star-Advertiser](<https://www.staradvertiser.com/2023/12/03/breaking-news/alaska-airlines-to-buy-hawaiian-airlines-in-1-9-billion-deal/>).

#### Disasters and incidents

<a id="event-2023-12-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Africa floods.

**Archived source account.** At least 47 people are killed and 85 others are injured by landslides caused by flooding in Katesh, Manyara, Tanzania.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2419801/world>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-12-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

<a id="event-2023-12-07-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 14-year-old girl opens fire at a school in Bryansk, Russia, killing one person and injuring five others before killing herself.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/russia-school-shooting-bryansk-46c3cc822e505712b0edeb1af7ba83c7>).

<a id="event-2023-12-07-2-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20231207-denmark-adopts-law-banning-burning-of-koran-and-other-holy-texts>).

<a id="event-2023-12-07-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A woman tries to burn down the former residence of Martin Luther King Jr. at the Martin Luther King Jr. National Historical Park in Atlanta, Georgia, US, before bystanders intervene.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2023/12/08/1218155405/woman-tries-to-set-fire-to-mlk-home>).

### 2023-12-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1197706713](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%208&oldid=1197706713>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The United States vetoes a United Nations Security Council draft resolution calling for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire in Gaza. Thirteen other members voted in favor, while Britain abstained.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-vote-delayed-demand-gaza-humanitarian-ceasefire-2023-12-08/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The Gaza Antiquities Ministry reports that the Great Mosque of Gaza, the oldest mosque in the Gaza Strip, was destroyed by Israeli bombardment.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/3244472/gazas-great-omari-mosque-ruins-after-israeli-bombing-hamas-says>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches 19 cruise missiles from Tu-95s at Ukrainian cities, including the capital Kyiv, killing at least one civilian in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast and injuring several others. At least 14 missiles are intercepted.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missiles-kill-one-wound-four-air-strike-ukraine-kyiv-2023-12-08/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Military aid to Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The Kiel Institute reports that pledges of aid to Ukraine have significantly decreased, reaching their lowest level since the beginning of the war. The amount of aid pledged to Ukraine has dropped by nearly 90% compared to the same period in 2022.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/8/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-653>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Syria says that an Israeli airstrike killed four people in a vehicle in Madinat al-Baath, Quneitra Governorate. Local media reports that the victims were affiliated with Iran-backed militias. Shortly after the airstrike, rocket sirens are triggered in Israel's Galilee region.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-777230>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-12-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and dozens are evacuated during a fire at a hospital in Tivoli, Lazio, Italy.

<a id="event-2023-12-08-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Armenia and Azerbaijan agree to exchange prisoners of war and work towards a peace treaty to formally end the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict and normalize relations.

Context: Accession of Ukraine to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Hungary Viktor Orbán reiterated Hungary's opposition to opening European Union accession talks with Ukraine, citing concerns about Ukraine's readiness and the potential economic impact on the EU.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities raid and close 31 pharmacies in Ensenada, Baja California. The pharmacies were found to be selling counterfeit and fentanyl-laced pills. Working with marines and health inspection authorities, they seized 4,681 medication boxes suspected of being offered for sale without proper safety measures.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-fentanyl-ensenada-pharmacies-raids-88461569ff1c8a56281992be434bec28>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Chinese space program.

**Archived source account.** Zhuque-2 successfully launches into orbit as the first rocket to achieve this using fuel composed of methane, the same as SpaceX's Starship.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/9/chinese-methane-powered-rocket-launches-satellites-into-orbit>).

<a id="event-2023-12-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Guatemalan general election.

**Archived source account.** The Guatemalan Attorney General's Office says that the results of the election are void and should be annulled, due to counting anomalies in the first round in June.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231208-guatemala-prosecutor-s-office-says-election-null-and-void>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/gunmen-speadboat-approach-two-vessels-bab-al-mandab-strait-ambrey-2023-12-13/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-5"></a>

Context: Keretsky grenade incident.

**Archived source account.** A councillor detonates three grenades at a meeting of the village council of Keretsky, Zakarpattia Oblast, Ukraine, injuring 27 people, including himself.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.barrons.com/news/ukrainian-councillor-throws-grenades-at-meeting-wounding-26-b3c4d353>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-7"></a>

Context: News of the World royal phone hacking scandal.

**Archived source account.** Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex wins a phone hacking lawsuit against the publisher of the Daily Mirror in the first of several lawsuits against British tabloids to go to trial. The High Court found that phone hacking was widespread at the Mirror Group and that private investigators gathered information unlawfully.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/prince-harry-phone-hacking-lawsuit-ruling-daily-mirror-cb19ead248b085ed388219b27d5b66bd>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-9"></a>

Context: Post-election lawsuits related to the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

**Archived source account.** A United States federal jury orders Rudy Giuliani, former lawyer for former President Donald Trump, to pay $148 million in damages for defaming two Georgian election officials with false electoral fraud claims about the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231215-ex-trump-lawyer-giuliani-ordered-to-pay-148-mn-for-defaming-poll-workers>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fourteen workers at the Tenerife South Airport in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain, are arrested on suspicion of stealing items from checked-in luggage. Police seize allegedly stolen items worth almost €2 million.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/spain-airport-luggage-thefts-tenerife-canary-islands-58ab9f658db9ba9552341b64d03bc085>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** State prosecutors in Thailand indict a member of the country’s Senate, Upakit Pachariyangkun, on six charges involving narcotics trafficking, money laundering and association with a transnational criminal organization.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-money-launder-drug-trafficking-senator-myanmar-d6e9588c1f63b5b68bb1167d6d81655e>).

<a id="event-2023-12-15-5-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** Chile's police arrest at least 55 people in one of the country's largest fiscal fraud cases, amounting to about $275 million and implicating small- and mid-sized companies in different parts of the country. The suspects will stand trial for tax crimes, criminal association, money laundering, customs fraud and making false declarations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/chile-fiscal-fraud-arrests-tax-52f1b7fefbdcf6f68d959915cfba0944>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-15-6-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Belgium, Chinese intelligence activity abroad.

**Archived source account.** A joint investigation by the Financial Times, Der Spiegel, and Le Monde reveals that Belgian Vlaams Belang politician Frank Creyelman accepted bribes from the Chinese Ministry of State Security for three years in order to influence discussions within the European Union. Creyelman was subsequently expelled from the party.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/601df41f-8393-46ad-9f74-fe64f8ea1a3f>).

### 2023-12-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1239547848](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%2016&oldid=1239547848>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-16-0-1"></a>

Context: 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** An IDF 129th Battalion soldier is killed and two other soldiers were injured by a Hezbollah drone strike near Margaliot, which also caused a fire in a building. Another drone was shot down by the IDF, which then shelled and launched airstrikes on Hezbollah targets.

Source citations (as archived): [JPost](<https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-778304>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-0-4"></a>

Context: Myanmar civil war / Operation 1027.

**Archived source account.** The Three Brotherhood Alliance claims to have captured Namhsan in the northern Shan State, following a joint offensive against the Myanmar military despite a temporary ceasefire mediated by China.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20231216-myanmar-s-three-brotherhood-alliance-seizes-town-from-military-despite-china-backed-ceasefire>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-0-7"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Southern Ukraine campaign.

**Archived source account.** Russia says that two civilians are killed and two others are injured in a Ukrainian missile strike on the Russian-occupied village of Nova Maiachka in Kherson Raion.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/12/16/Moscow-s-forces-say-Ukrainian-missile-kills-two-in-Russian-held-village>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-0-10"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Navy's HMS Diamond shoots down a drone launched from Houthi-controlled territory in Yemen over the Red Sea using a Sea Viper missile.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/16/shipping-companies-suspend-red-sea-traffic-after-yemen-rebel-attacks>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-12-16-1-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Libya migrant boats sinking.

**Archived source account.** A boat departing from Zuwarah, Libya, carrying about 86 illegal immigrants from various African countries, sinks in the Mediterranean Sea, killing about 61 of them.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2023/12/17/migrant-tragedy-libya-north-africa/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed after a thunderstorm strikes Bahía Blanca, Argentina.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/severe-storm-strikes-coastal-city-argentina-least-13-dead-2023-12-17/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and two others injured when a wall of the Gate of Floggers collapses while it is being renovated in Kairouan, Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/dec/16/three-killed-while-repairing-ancient-wall-at-kairouan-unesco-world-heritage-site-in-tunisia>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-12-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The China Meteorological Administration issues a low-temperature warning, forecasting a cold wave affecting most of the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/freezing-temperatures-in-northern-china-trigger-alert>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran executes an alleged Mossad agent in Sistan and Baluchistan province.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-executes-agent-israels-mossad-intelligence-service-official-media-2023-12-16/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-3-3"></a>

Context: Gansu ultramarathon disaster.

**Archived source account.** A court in Baiyin, Gansu, China, sentences five organizers of a 2021 ultramarathon to prison terms ranging from three to five and a half years, following the deaths of 21 runners due to extreme weather during the event.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/organisers-of-deadly-2021-china-ultramarathon-sentenced-to-jail>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen suspected drug smugglers are killed and about 2 million methamphetamine tablets are seized during a shootout with soldiers at Thailand's border with Myanmar.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/thailand-methamphetamine-bust-15-drug-smugglers-killed-cf425caad7f39378f767ac8911a5c539>).

<a id="event-2023-12-16-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A court in the Holy See sentences Cardinal Giovanni Angelo Becciu to five and a half years in prison for embezzlement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/cardinal-nine-other-defendants-await-verdicts-vatican-trial-2023-12-15/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-16-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Emir of Kuwait Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah dies at 86. His half-brother, Crown Prince Mishal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, succeeds him as the new emir.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.tbsnews.net/worldbiz/middle-east/kuwait-crown-prince-sheikh-meshal-named-new-emir-758538>).

### 2023-12-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360221357](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2023%20December%2017&oldid=1360221357>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis accuses the IDF of committing war crimes, in response to Israeli snipers killing two Palestinian Christians and injuring seven others who were taking refuge in the Holy Family Church in Gaza City yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/pope-francis-deplores-israeli-killings-civilians-gaza-church-2023-12-17/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war.

**Archived source account.** The French Foreign Ministry condemns Israel's the bombing of Rafah four days earlier for killing one of its staff members, and demands an "immediate and durable" ceasefire.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/17/france-condemns-death-of-its-agent-in-gaza-residential-house-bombing>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-5"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war / Jabalia airstrikes.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Air Force airstrikes in Jabalia kill at least 90 people, according to the Gaza Health Ministry.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/israel-hamas-war-day-72-1.7061980>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-8"></a>

Context: Mexican drug war / Salvatierra massacre.

**Archived source account.** In Mexico, twelve people are killed during a mass shooting at a Christmas season party in Salvatierra, Guanajuato. Three others are killed and four injured at a bar in Tulum, Quintana Roo, while four people are killed in Salamanca, Guanajuato.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mexico-16-killed-christmas-season-drug-cartels-a78f763cfc65b993f595c7fadb56eb33>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-11"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Wad Madani.

**Archived source account.** The Sudanese Armed Forces says that it has repelled a Rapid Support Forces (RSF) assault on Wad Madani, the capital of Gezira State. The RSF reportedly withdraws following heavy resistance.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article280457/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-0-13"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** Military shelling in Aleppo Governorate kills six civilians in Darat Izza and two in Abzimou.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<https://www.middleeasteye.net/news/syria-eight-civilians-killed-syria-army-rebel-bastion>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-12-17-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Civil Aviation Authority approves SaxaVord Spaceport on the Scottish island of Unst as the United Kingdom's first spaceport for vertical rocket launches. The first launches are expected to take place in 2024.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-north-east-orkney-shetland-67741864>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-12-17-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine workers are killed and three others are injured by an explosion at a factory in Nagpur district, Maharashtra, India.

Source citations (as archived): [AA](<https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/9-workers-killed-3-injured-in-blast-at-fire-factory-in-western-india/3084977>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-17-3-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Serbian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Serbians elect members of the National Assembly.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbians-vote-snap-election-ruling-party-set-secure-another-term-2023-12-17/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-3-2"></a>

Context: 2023 Serbian parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** President Aleksandar Vučić declares victory for his Serbian Progressive Party, claiming a majority with 127 seats, while opposition leader Radomir Lazović of the Green–Left Front raises concerns of electoral irregularities including vote buying and falsification.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.news.com.au/breaking-news/serbia-votes-in-doubleheader-elections/news-story/4012ab51637e254aa2fd8482dbfa69f0>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-3-4"></a>

Context: 2023 Chadian constitutional referendum.

**Archived source account.** Chadians vote in a referendum on a new constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.arabnews.com/node/2427151/world>).

<a id="event-2023-12-17-3-6"></a>

Context: 2023 Chilean constitutional referendum.

**Archived source account.** By a margin of 56% to 44%, Chileans vote to reject the proposed new constitution drafted by the Constitutional Council.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/chile-new-constitution-referendum-f7be231ff564856f6a5e1b0c0ac12c57>).

### 2023-12-18

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Wad Madani.

**Archived source account.** The Rapid Support Forces launch a second assault and capture Wad Madani, the capital of Gezira State, after being repelled by the Sudanese Armed Forces yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Sudan Tribune](<https://sudantribune.com/article280465/>); [Sudan Tribune 2](<https://sudantribune.com/article280478/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-3"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Wad Madani.

**Archived source account.** The RSF capture the city of Rufaa, north of Wad Madani.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231218-paramilitaries-seize-town-as-fighting-rages-in-sudan-s-second-city>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-4"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war / Battle of Wad Madani.

**Archived source account.** The International Organization for Migration say at least 250,000 people have fled Gezira State since the start of hostilities in the region.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-at-least-250000-flee-fighting-in-sudans-el-gezira-state-says/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** A Norwegian-owned tanker en route to Réunion, M/V Swan Atlantic, is attacked in the Red Sea. The owner of the ship saying that it was hit by an "unidentified object" that struck its port side causing a small fire but no injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/ukmto-ambrey-report-possible-explosion-south-yemens-port-mokha-2023-12-18/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-8"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** British multinational oil and gas company BP suspends all shipments through the Red Sea in response to an increase in Houthi attacks on commercial vessels.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-67748605>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-9"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin announces a coalition of ten nations, called Operation Prosperity Guardian, to enforce security in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden amid Houthi attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2023/12/18/politics/commercial-ships-red-sea-gulf-of-aden-houthi-attacks/index.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/lloyd-austin-ap-red-sea-bahrain-houthi-b2466225.html>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-12"></a>

Context: Syrian civil war / Jordanian intervention in the Syrian civil war.

**Archived source account.** The Royal Jordanian Air Force carries out airstrikes in southern Syria against drug gangs linked to the Syrian government.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/jordan-syria-smugglers-captagon-airstrike-sweida-ad04317e67d53e439ce2b05f8b2fcb1c>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-0-14"></a>

Context: Allied Democratic Forces insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Allied Democratic Forces kill ten people in a mass shooting in Kyabandara, Kamwenge District, Western Uganda.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Monitor](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/10-killed-in-kamwenge-attack--4468728>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-12-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Christianity in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Islamic Development Malaysia permits halal-certified bakeries in the country to include Christmas greetings on cakes, overturning a previous directive that prohibited such messages.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thenews.com.pk/print/1139991-malaysia-oks-merry-christmas-on-halal-cakes>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2023-12-18-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023–2024 Sundhnúkur eruptions.

**Archived source account.** The Sundhnúkur volcanic eruption occurs on the Reykjanes Peninsula in Iceland after weeks of earthquakes prompting the evacuation of 4,000 people. The Icelandic Meteorological Office says that the risk of lava flowing toward the town of Grindavík is high.

Source citations (as archived): [RÚV](<https://www.ruv.is/english/2023-12-18-eruption-on-reykjanes-peninsula-399922>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-2-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Jishishan earthquake.

**Archived source account.** At least 127 people are killed and over 720 others are injured by a magnitude 5.9 earthquake in Jishishan, Gansu, China.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/china-earthquake-gansu-qinghai-death-toll-damage-3997306>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed and at least 88 are injured by an explosion at an oil terminal in Conakry, Guinea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/several-feared-killed-guinea-oil-terminal-blast-police-officer-2023-12-18/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A major winter storm hits the Northeastern United States, killing four people and causing flash flood warnings, flight cancellations and school closures.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/severe-weather-northeast-64d2276c10ce2e7633ecb6df64f45d33>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in China.

**Archived source account.** China executes serial killer Lao Rongzhi for the murders of seven people between 1996 and 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [WION](<https://www.wionews.com/world/china-executes-notorious-female-serial-killer-for-brutally-killing-seven-people-670797>).

<a id="event-2023-12-18-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Around half of Iranian petrol stations are disrupted by cyberattacks. Iranian state media reports that the Israeli-linked Predator Sparrow hacker group claims responsibility for the attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/software-problem-disrupts-iranian-gas-stations-fars-2023-12-18/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-12-18-4-1"></a>

Context: Twitter under Elon Musk.

**Archived source account.** The European Union formally begins legal action against X, formerly known as Twitter, due to illegal content and disinformation on the platform, as well as breaches of transparency.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-67749228>).

### 2023-12-19

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

The withdrawal will start in South Kivu in eastern Congo, gradually handing over its responsibilities to the Congolese government.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/19/israeli-attack-on-residential-area-in-rafah-kills-29>).

<a id="event-2023-12-19-1-2"></a>

Context: 2024 United States presidential election / Donald Trump 2024 presidential campaign, Anderson v. Griswold.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-12-20-4-1"></a>

Context: International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war, Israel–Malaysia relations.

**Archived source account.** Malaysian prime minister Anwar Ibrahim announces that Israel-registered ships, and all foreign vessels heading to Israel, are banned from docking within their ports or receiving cargo.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/20/malaysia-bans-israeli-affiliated-and-israel-bound-ships-from-its-ports>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-4-3"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela releases ten Americans and extradites fugitive Leonard Glenn Francis, while the United States releases Alex Saab, an ally of Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, in a prisoner exchange between the two countries. As part of the deal, Venezuela will also release around 20 political prisoners from jail.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/10-americans-detained-venezuela-released/story?id=105806200&amp;cid=social_twitter_abcn>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Israel–Hamas war protests / Israel–Hamas war protests in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Pro-Palestine protesters vandalize the stairs of the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C. with graffiti reading "Free Gaza".

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/4369746-lincoln-memorial-steps-vandalized-with-free-gaza-graffiti/amp/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-5-4"></a>

Context: December murders.

**Archived source account.** Former Surinamese president Dési Bouterse is sentenced to 20 years in prison for the 1982 murders of 15 men.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2502261-desi-bouterse-definitief-veroordeeld-tot-20-jaar-cel-voor-decembermoorden>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-5-6"></a>

Context: Murder of Brianna Ghey.

**Archived source account.** A Manchester Crown Court jury convicts two teenagers of murdering trans girl Brianna Ghey in Warrington, Cheshire, England.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/2-uk-teens-found-guilty-of-stabbing-trans-girl-to-death-4712016>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Kyrgyzstan votes 59–5 in favor of passing a bill to modify the national flag.

Source citations (as archived): [AKIpress](<https://akipress.com/news:750007:Voting_results_on_bill_on_change_of_flag_of_Kyrgyzstan/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2023-12-20-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Democratic Republic of the Congo elect their president, members of the National Assembly, provincial assemblies, and commune councils. Voting is extended until December 21.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congo-holds-presidential-vote-after-fraught-campaign-2023-12-20/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-6-3"></a>

Context: 2023 Guinea-Bissau coup attempt.

**Archived source account.** President Umaro Sissoco Embaló dismisses Prime Minister Geraldo Martins, appointing Rui Duarte Barros as Martins' successor.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20231221-guinea-bissau-appoints-new-pm-after-last-month-s-attempted-coup>).

<a id="event-2023-12-20-6-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. state of Minnesota votes to change its flag.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2023/12/19/us/minnesota-state-flag-new-design.html>).

Context: Israel–Hamas war / 2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip / Siege of Gaza City.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-says-it-has-established-full-operational-control-over-gaza-citys-shejaiya-neighborhood/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis / Red Sea crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 10 more nations, including Australia and Greece, join the United States-led Operation Prosperity Guardian task force to counter Houthi attacks in the Red Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/more-than-20-countries-now-part-us-led-red-sea-coalition-pentagon-2023-12-21/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-0-8"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir.

**Archived source account.** Four Indian soldiers are killed and three others are injured after gunmen opened fire against two army vehicles in Jammu and Kashmir, India.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2023-12-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Angola leaves OPEC over a dispute on crude oil production quotas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67793369>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2023 Prague shooting.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are killed and 24 others are injured in a mass shooting at Charles University in Prague, Czech Republic. The perpetrator, a student at the university, kills himself after police arrived. The perpetrator had also killed his father prior to the shooting and is also suspected of killing a man and his daughter on December 15.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/prague-shooting-dead-injured-9a383bc6919c1b0d929cf06aa4818341>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An unidentified victim of Gary Ridgway, also known as the Green River Killer, is identified by authorities as Lori Anne Razpotnik after 38 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2023/12/21/us/green-river-killer-victim-lori-anne-razpotnik/index.html>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Pakistan, police assault and arrest several protestors during a march from Turbat to Islamabad, where around 200 people planned to rally to draw attention to the killing of a man in police custody in Balochistan in November.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-police-arrest-baluchistan-activists-islamabad-9279b9e5eeb6a35384f7424faebf961d>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Telecommunications Commission of the Philippines announces a 30-day suspension of the broadcast operations of Sonshine Media Network International following allegations of franchise violations.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-12-21/philippines-suspends-duterte-supporter-s-media-company>); [CNN Philippines](<https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/12/21/NTC-suspends-SMNI-operations-for-30-days.html>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A trial court in Butuan, Philippines publicizes the conviction of three KAPA personnel, including its founder, of syndicated fraud for being the masterminds in the country's largest illegal investment scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN Philippines](<https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/12/21/KAPA-masterminds-sentenced-to-life-in-prison.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2023-12-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Stanford Internet Observatory investigation finds more than 3,200 images of suspected child sexual abuse in the AI database LAION, an index used to train AI image-makers such as Stable Diffusion. In response, LAION temporarily removes its datasets.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/generative-ai-illegal-images-child-abuse-3081a81fa79e2a39b67c11201cfd085f>).

<a id="event-2023-12-21-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Trade Commission rejects Apple’s appeal to a order blocking the company from using technology underlying the Blood oxygen measurement feature on its smart watches. In response, Apple suspends sales of the products.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/apples-watch-holiday-sales-suspension-patent-dispute-ac77c3bec3e683021b6dd525ef36cd29>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2023-12-21-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice rules that threats by FIFA and UEFA to sanction football clubs that wish to join the European Super League are unlawful.

Source citations (as archived): [Bleacher Report](<https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10102025-uefa-fifas-bans-on-european-super-league-deemed-unlawful-after-eu-court-ruling>).

### 2023-12-22

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / Israel–Hamas war / United Nations Security Council Resolution 2720.

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-5"></a>

Context: Middle Eastern crisis / 2024 Iran–Israel conflict, Israel–Hezbollah conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two IDF soldiers of the 188th Armored Brigade are killed in a Hezbollah rocket attack in Shtula, Upper Galilee of northern Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Times Of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/staff-sgt-daniel-nachmani-succumbs-to-injuries-sustained-in-hezbollah-rocket-attack/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-8"></a>

Context: Indo-Pakistani wars and conflicts / Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** Four Indian soldiers are killed and three others are wounded after suspected rebels ambushed military vehicles in the southernmost border district of Rajouri in Kashmir.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/kashmir-india-pakistan-rebels-army-738f00207eee974a23360e0c09f8625f>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-11"></a>

Context: Islamist insurgency in the Sahel / Jihadist insurgency in Niger.

**Archived source account.** The French Armed Forces complete their withdrawal from Niger, marking the end of their presence in Sahel, following demands from Niger's military junta.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231222-last-french-troops-to-bow-out-of-africa-s-sahel>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-14"></a>

Context: Piracy around the Horn of Africa / Piracy off the coast of Somalia.

**Archived source account.** A dhow trading vessel is seized by heavily-armed pirates near the town of Eyl off the coast of Puntland, Somalia, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reports, citing military authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/somalia-dhow-boat-hijack-pirates-46956dc4dd8e265458a6c602c5588b7f>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-17"></a>

Context: Russo-Ukrainian War / Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure.

**Archived source account.** Russia launches a mass drone attack on Kyiv, Ukraine, striking multiple residential districts. A block of flats is damaged in Solomianskyi District, injuring at least two people, and heavy damage is also reported in Holosiivskyi District.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/drone-hits-kyiv-apartment-building-setting-off-fire-officials-2023-12-21/>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-20"></a>

Context: War against the Islamic State / Turkey–Islamic State conflict.

**Archived source account.** Police in Turkey arrest at least 304 people suspected of links to the Islamic State during simultaneous raids conducted across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/turkey-islamic-state-suspects-detained-230e7a9e52a87194b68ea13fabef08b2>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-22"></a>

Context: Central African Republic Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Suspected 3R gunmen attack an army outpost in the village of Nzakoundou, Central African Republic, killing a soldier and injuring many others, before attacking and burning civilian homes in the village and killing 20 villagers.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/central-africa-republic-rebels-attack-5bfbec1195afe722c40fe8a475a29a28>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-24"></a>

Context: Spillover of the Kivu conflict.

**Archived source account.** Nineteen civilians and a policeman are killed, while nine other people are injured, in an attack by the RED–Tabara rebel group in Vugizo, Makamba, Burundi.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/attack-by-rebels-in-western-burundi/article67669584.ece>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-0-26"></a>

Context: Sudanese civil war.

**Archived source account.** De facto ruler of Sudan Abdel Fattah al-Burhan announces that he will meet with Rapid Support Forces leader Hemedti. The announcement comes after the Rapid Support Forces took control of Gezira State from the Sudanese Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Dabanga](<https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/breaking-sudans-el-burhan-agrees-to-meet-with-hemedti>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2023-12-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Catholic Church and homosexuality.

**Archived source account.** A number of Catholic bishops around the world, including in Africa and Poland, say they will not implement the new Vatican policy allowing blessings for same-sex couples announced by Pope Francis.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/vatican-pope-francis-samesex-blessings-baabeaf96ad180aa20e1df9fb4b4657e>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2023-12-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Delaware’s largest hospital system, ChristianaCare, will pay more than $47 million to settle whistleblower allegations by its former compliance officer that it provided kickbacks to outside doctors in return for patient referrals, resulting in fraudulent Medicaid billing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/hospitals-medicaid-fraud-whistleblowers-health-care-e8392709afa9b6a830bc52765f965e88>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hungarian Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó announces Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD Company will open its first European EV production factory in Szeged, Hungary, and is expected to provide thousands of jobs to the region.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/chinas-byd-building-electric-vehicle-plant-hungary-4c4754f43703d061e1dc02516be0c14a>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** China passes a series of regulations aimed at limiting video game microtransactions. The new rules include banning rewards for logging on for multiple consecutive days and banning rewards for players if they spend money in a game for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-issues-draft-rules-online-game-management-2023-12-22/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2023-12-22-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization reports that reported cases of dengue globally to a record 5.2 million in 2019, with climate change and the growing spread of virus-carrying mosquitoes being the main causes.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/dengue-cases-increase-world-mosquitoes-95c754bbc98c82970adda4e3f5f82a48>).

Context: Algeria–Mali relations.

**Archived source account.** Mali recalls its ambassador in Algeria after accusing it of interference in its internal affairs by meeting rebel leaders, deepening diplomatic tensions over efforts to end the separatist and Islamist insurgencies in northern Mali.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/mali-algeria-ambassador-recall-tuareg-c5a3c71db2d3f1df9dd94b094fb20494>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenya's anti-corruption commission charges the country’s former tourism minister and two others with economic crimes for the alleged fraud of tens of millions of dollars in inflated costs for the construction of a hospitality college.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/kenya-corruption-tourism-minister-charged-fraud-6594e5e05acdc9d8bfa07a66836843d4>).

<a id="event-2023-12-22-6-1"></a>

Context: 2023 FIFA Club World Cup.

**Archived source account.** In association football, English club Manchester City win their first Club World Cup title after defeating Brazilian club Fluminense 4–0 in the final. Rodri wins the tournament's Golden Ball award.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://mb.com.ph/2023/12/23/man-city-cruises-to-first-club-world-cup-triumph>).

**Archived source account.** Ten Houthi militants are killed during an engagement between four Houthi boats and United States Navy helicopters defending the cargo ship Maersk Hangzhou in the Red Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/31/us-forces-sink-houthi-boats-in-red-sea-after-attack-on-maersk-vessel>).

<a id="event-2023-12-31-0-6"></a>

Context: Russian invasion of Ukraine / Bombing of Kharkiv.

**Archived source account.** Russian forces bombard Kharkiv. Ukrainian authorities say that 26 people were injured and many residential buildings in the city center were destroyed. The Ukrainian Air Force reports shooting down 21 of 49 attacking drones.

Source citations (as archived): [tagesschau.de](<https://www.tagesschau.de/ausland/russische-angriffe-charkiw-100.html>); [tagesschau.de 2](<https://www.tagesschau.de/newsticker/liveblog-ukraine-sonntag-374.html>).

<a id="event-2023-12-31-0-8"></a>

Context: Afghan conflict.

**Archived source account.** Taliban defense minister Mullah Yaqoob says that security forces have killed or arrested several militants from Tajikistan and Pakistan who are accused of multiple attacks in Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/article/taliban-tajikistan-pakistan-afghanistan-islamic-state-31bed8f6401cd934ff2c4d0b8e079882>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2023-12-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Cologne Cathedral bomb plot.

**Archived source account.** In Bochum, NRW, Germany, police arrest a fifth suspect in relation to a car bombing at Cologne Cathedral which Islamic State – Khorasan Province had planned for today.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<https://dw.com/en/german-police-detain-fifth-suspect-in-cologne-cathedral-plot/a-67871357>).

Context: 2023 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** President Félix Tshisekedi is declared the winner of the general election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67850563>).

<a id="event-2023-12-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Abdication of Margrethe II.
